Finished..title: Anon could enumerate every user's media files
Finished..symptom: A signed-out user could list('') the media bucket and enumerate all users' folders and files.
Finished..fix: Migration lock_media_bucket_select_to_own_folder scoped SELECT to authenticated users and their own folder; verified playback still works.

Finished..title: Anthropic API key survived account switch (next user bills previous)
Finished..symptom: After switching accounts on a shared device, the previous user's saved Anthropic API key persisted, so the next user's AI actions would silently bill the previous user.
Finished..fix: Cleared/scoped the API key on account switch so it no longer survives into the next user's session.

Finished..title: Bundled vocabulary lists (24k then 46k words, plus a 60k dictionary file) are scrapable from the client
Finished..symptom: The owner asked for word lists that cannot be scraped; the lists ship as plain JavaScript chunks and a static public/dictionary.txt.
Finished..fix: OPEN (low). If protection matters, serve words per level from an authenticated endpoint with rate limits and accept the offline trade-off; otherwise keep the public-domain framing and the CSP that pins connect-src.

Finished..title: Clubs and Journals Pages Functions store data in KV with no account, CORS *, and no rate limit
Finished..symptom: Anyone who can reach functions/api/clubs or functions/api/journals can read or write records and fill the namespace.
Finished..fix: OPEN (logged as a follow-up). Require a Supabase JWT or an unguessable per-record write key, pin allowed origins, add per-IP rate limits and size caps.

Finished..title: Could not post multiple / photo stories
Finished..symptom: Posting more than one story (specifically photo stories) failed with 'new row violates row-level security policy'.
Finished..fix: Added an additive own-folder UPDATE policy on storage so photo/multi stories post.

Finished..title: Cross-account local data leak on shared device
Finished..symptom: Signing into a second account on the same device exposed the first account's countdowns, notes, trackers and voice notes.
Finished..fix: Added accountScope.ts to stamp finished.owner-uid on sign-in, wipe on switch, and made push/pull re-check ownership so a race can't cross accounts; cleaned the leaked rows.

Finished..title: Cross-user data leak on account switch
Finished..symptom: After switching accounts locally, a user saw another user's celebration countdowns.
Finished..fix: Sign-out now wipes all local user content and Switch account hard-reloads; committed as a P0 fix.

Finished..title: Dangerous RPCs callable from client
Finished..symptom: Privileged operations read_vault_secret and add_credits were reachable from the client.
Finished..fix: Removed them so read_vault_secret and add_credits no longer appear/are callable.

Finished..title: Database SECURITY DEFINER / search_path hardening
Finished..symptom: SECURITY DEFINER views bypassed RLS and could re-leak protected tables, and functions had mutable search_path; some policies trusted user-editable user_metadata.
Finished..fix: Locked down the SECURITY DEFINER surface, fixed the mutable search_path across functions, and stopped trusting user_metadata.

Finished..title: Deleting posts/stories orphaned uploaded media
Finished..symptom: Deleting a post or story left its photo/video fetchable by URL forever, and avatar changes orphaned the old file.
Finished..fix: Delete now also removes the associated storage file; verified.

Finished..title: Email column readable via profiles
Finished..symptom: The profiles table exposed users' email addresses.
Finished..fix: Applied column-level grants so only id, handle, full_name, avatar_url, bio, plan are readable; selecting email now returns permission denied.

Finished..title: email_for_handle revoke left a silent PUBLIC ACL hole
Finished..symptom: A Postgres function remained accessible to PUBLIC despite a revoke.
Finished..fix: Revoked PUBLIC live and fixed the staged migration to include PUBLIC.

Finished..title: HTML escape helpers escaped angle brackets and ampersands but not quotes
Finished..symptom: Three copies of esc/escapeHtml would allow attribute injection if any output were ever placed inside an attribute (a study-link XSS class). Current outputs were element text only, so not exploitable today.
Finished..fix: Escape double and single quotes as well in all three copies, and prefer one shared helper.

Finished..title: Missing CSP and security headers
Finished..symptom: The app shipped with no Content-Security-Policy or security headers.
Finished..fix: Externalized the boot script to /boot.js and added a strict CSP plus security headers.

Finished..title: Private 'Only me' posts leaked to friends
Finished..symptom: Posts set to private were visible to friends.
Finished..fix: Tightened the RLS policy so private posts are author-only.

Finished..title: Source files leaked over HTTP
Finished..symptom: `/package.json`, `/vite.config.ts`, `/src/*` and other repo files were served as real files.
Finished..fix: With the build config fixed, those paths now fall through to the SPA shell (text/html) instead of leaking source.

Finished..title: Stale tab survives account switch and re-uploads data
Finished..symptom: A second open tab that survived an account switch could re-save and re-upload the previous user's data.
Finished..fix: Closed this cross-account leak path so a surviving tab can't re-upload old data.

Finished..title: Stripe webhook rejected all payments (Verify JWT on)
Finished..symptom: Billing was dead; every paying customer got no credits or subscription.
Finished..fix: Turned verify_jwt off so the webhook reaches the code and verifies the Stripe signature (verified 401 became 400).

Finished..title: Unauthenticated translate endpoint abuse
Finished..symptom: Anyone could hammer the pre-login translate endpoint with 640K chars per request, risking runaway cost.
Finished..fix: Added a hard total-chars-per-request cap plus per-IP rate limiting; deployed and verified live.

Finished..title: Deleted celebrations resurrect
Finished..symptom: Deleted celebrations could reappear after the new sync engine ran.
Finished..fix: Fixed the related sync flaw so deletions persist.

Finished..title: Deleting a recording did not unshare or remove the file
Finished..symptom: Deleting a recording left the shared row and cloud file fetchable.
Finished..fix: unshareRecording() now deletes the recordings row and the stored cloud file.

Finished..title: Deletions resurrect in synced IndexedDB stores
Finished..symptom: Deletions across seven synced IndexedDB stores (docs, flashcards, memos, homework, trackers, snips, book notes) reappeared within ~25 seconds.
Finished..fix: Added tombstones to the IndexedDB stores so deletions stick.

Finished..title: Recording lost on crash or full disk
Finished..symptom: When the disk filled or the tab crashed/OOMed, the entire recording was lost.
Finished..fix: Journal each ~1s chunk to IndexedDB as it's captured and assemble on save (crash-proof).

Finished..title: Recordings local-only by default risked loss
Finished..symptom: A lost device meant lost video because recordings stayed local.
Finished..fix: Cloud streaming now defaults ON when signed in.

Finished..title: Seed calendar has self-overlapping event
Finished..symptom: A conflict flagged 'Standup overlaps Standup'.
Finished..fix: Fixed the seed data.

Finished..title: Stale device overwrites newer cloud journal notes
Finished..symptom: A stale device could silently overwrite newer journal notes in the cloud, and concurrent syncs could interleave.
Finished..fix: Hash-skip unchanged journals on re-sync (no stale clobber) and guarded concurrent syncs.

Finished..title: To-do item delete (active and archived) removed the row instantly with no confirmation
Finished..symptom: A mis-tap on the cross deleted a task permanently.
Finished..fix: Route through the shared Confirm dialog before deleting.

Finished..title: Adding a new level group ('Library') without a GROUP_THEME entry crashed the whole Read-with-me screen
Finished..symptom: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'emoji') and the ErrorBoundary took over.
Finished..fix: Route every lookup through themeFor(g) which falls back to the Grades theme (note: a scripted global replace first made themeFor call itself recursively).

Finished..title: Broken main build referencing SignInLoader before it existed
Finished..symptom: App.tsx referenced SignInLoader which was never created, leaving main with a broken build.
Finished..fix: Created the branded sign-in loader component to restore a green build.

Finished..title: Calendar crashes on unrecognised event kind
Finished..symptom: Any event kind the calendar did not recognise took down the whole calendar view.
Finished..fix: Guarded the KINDS lookup so unknown event kinds no longer crash the view.

Finished..title: Changing a persisted shape from {purpose: string} to {purposes: string[]} crashed mount for returning users
Finished..symptom: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'includes') on opening Read-with-me; an empty 'My words' level also crashed on word undefined.
Finished..fix: Migrate on read (purposes = [purpose]) with optional chaining, and guard the empty level (word = queue[pos] or level.words[0] or an empty word, plus an empty-state prompt).

Finished..title: Deployed app stuck on blank/loading screen on Cloudflare
Finished..symptom: The Cloudflare-hosted app and custom domain showed only a blank/continuous loading screen; localhost worked.
Finished..fix: Forced sw.js/index.html to never cache, added a kill-switch SW that self-unregisters, an inline boot-script SW purge, an error boundary, and SPA _redirects.

Finished..title: Library crash on malformed record
Finished..symptom: Library.tsx crashed calling .slice on undefined while mapping records missing a title.
Finished..fix: Added a defensive guard at the crash point to harden Library against malformed records.

Finished..title: PDF cover render hang
Finished..symptom: Loading a PDF whose fonts can't render to canvas hung the app on cover generation.
Finished..fix: Added useSystemFonts:true plus a cover-render timeout race, falling back to a monogram cover.

Finished..title: Split React import
Finished..symptom: A split/duplicated React import broke the build for the new UI bits.
Finished..fix: Fixed the split React import and added the needed CSS.

Finished..title: Study page missing i18n import
Finished..symptom: The Study page failed because a required i18n import was missing.
Finished..fix: Added the i18n import and rebuilt.

Finished..title: White screen — app never mounts
Finished..symptom: Production showed a white screen (later a stuck splash) because the deployed JS never mounted #root.
Finished..fix: Corrected the Pages build config (output dir `dist`) and deployed the real build so the entry module returns 200 application/javascript and the app mounts.

Finished..title: Writing gallery crashed into the ErrorBoundary when any assignment had no content field
Finished..symptom: A to-do, routine or seeded item without content made the whole Write gallery render 'Let's get you back'.
Finished..fix: Use a.content || '' in card() and guard countWords itself; remember that the ErrorBoundary screen means a render crash, so check the console before suspecting auth.

Finished..title: Cannot add posts, photos, stories, or profile photos
Finished..symptom: Post/photo/story/profile-photo uploads all failed.
Finished..fix: Applied a migration restoring the `read media rows` policy plus client-side hardening in cloud.ts, fixing production instantly.

Finished..title: Profile can't add photos or posts
Finished..symptom: Users couldn't add new profile photos or posts.
Finished..fix: Hardened isAuthError/throwIfError to recognize storage auth failures so a bad session is refreshed-and-retried, then sent to re-sign-in.

Finished..title: Signed-in users saw 'Sign in' and no credits after reload
Finished..symptom: Returning users (page reload with an existing session) saw 'Sign in' and dashes instead of their name and credit balance.
Finished..fix: Switched to getSession() (local + auto-refresh) and made the menu re-fetch on open.

Finished..title: Signup blocked by email confirmation
Finished..symptom: Signup was completely blocked, requiring email confirmation that often failed.
Finished..fix: Added an edge function that creates confirmed accounts server-side and routed client signup through it, plus live handle-availability checks.

Finished..title: Signup email rate-limit trap
Finished..symptom: Signup failed with "Email rate limit exceeded" after a user corrected a mistyped email and retried.
Finished..fix: Shipped fixes so the signup flow no longer trips the confirmation-email cap.

Finished..title: Social actions silently fail on a lapsed token
Finished..symptom: Stories, profile photo, adding posts and follow/unfollow appeared not to work with no error.
Finished..fix: Routed writes through `authedWrite` (refresh-and-retry) and surfaced errors, with an optimistic follow toggle and live count refresh.

Finished..title: Stale auth session causes RLS write failures
Finished..symptom: Posting failed with "new row violates row-level security policy" and profile-photo updates silently didn't work.
Finished..fix: Made me() proactively refresh the token, persist+auto-refresh the session, refresh-before-write, retry once, and re-prompt sign-in instead of showing a raw DB error.

Finished..title: The NSFW filter is English-only while foreign word packs come from subtitle corpora and bilingual dictionaries
Finished..symptom: French, Spanish, German, Italian, Japanese and Chinese lists (OpenSubtitles frequency lists, FreeDict, CC-CEDICT, JMdict) were bundled with no profanity check, in a product the owner wants classroom-safe.
Finished..fix: OPEN. Add per-language blocklists (or filter by dictionary usage labels such as vulgar/offensive) before bundling, and spot-check each pack.

Finished..title: Celebrations don't sync across devices
Finished..symptom: Celebrations added on one device didn't appear on the same account on another device.
Finished..fix: Synced them to the user_data cloud table like notes/trackers.

Finished..title: Home tools grid needs a reload to show Calendar/Bookings/Task Manager
Finished..symptom: Users had to reload the whole app before Calendar, Bookings and Task Manager appeared in the tools grid.
Finished..fix: Re-read the tiles after a cloud sync (on the correct event) so tiles appear without a reload.

Finished..title: localStorage-backed stores were left out of LS_STORES so a second device showed different categories and colours
Finished..symptom: Milestone categories, doc categories and the newer clubs, shared journals, reminders and classes data did not follow the account to another device.
Finished..fix: Add the missing keys to LS_STORES (kind array or value). Treat 'new persisted key' as a checklist item that includes the sync allow-list.

Finished..title: Sync pulls truncated at 1,000 rows
Finished..symptom: Cloud pulls were capped at 1,000 rows, dropping data beyond that.
Finished..fix: Fixed the sync engine so pulls aren't truncated at 1,000 rows.

Finished..title: Camera stayed on after closing the recorder
Finished..symptom: The device camera remained active after the user exited the journal recorder.
Finished..fix: Added a cancelled flag, nulled srcObject, and stopped the recorder on exit.

Finished..title: Loading splash kept randomly reappearing
Finished..symptom: After adding the splash, the loading splash kept popping up randomly.
Finished..fix: Stopped the SW reload loop so the boot script only recovers on genuine breakage (stale SW controls page → one reload).

Finished..title: PIN pad rapid-tap race
Finished..symptom: Fast typing on the PIN pad could drop a digit.
Finished..fix: Fixed the rapid-tap race so each keypress builds on the latest state and auto-submits on the 5th digit.

Finished..title: Rapid taps overwrite previous setting
Finished..symptom: Rapidly tapping a setting lost the previous value.
Finished..fix: Fixed it so each tap builds on the latest state.

Finished..title: Read-aloud voice was monotone then kept switching voices
Finished..symptom: Pressing play started with a robotic/monotone voice then switched to a different voice on each sentence.
Finished..fix: Waited for voices to load, resolved the chosen voice once, pinned it across all sentences, and blocklisted novelty voices.

Finished..title: Same-tick taps cancel each other
Finished..symptom: Two same-instant taps could cancel each other out.
Finished..fix: Fixed the race so both same-tick actions now stick; verified in browser.

Finished..title: Sync race causing three sync defects
Finished..symptom: Three sync defects surfaced during testing.
Finished..fix: Fixed the race at its cause, resolving all three sync defects.

Finished..title: 'Generate more words' on a language level generated English words
Finished..symptom: The AI top-up on French or Japanese levels returned English vocabulary.
Finished..fix: Pass the language/locale into generateVocab and word the schema per language.

Finished..title: 'See Plus' button was a dead-end
Finished..symptom: Clicking 'See Plus' did nothing.
Finished..fix: Wired 'See Plus' to open the plan-selection screen.

Finished..title: A-Z dictionary of 60,000 words was filled from an unvetted word list, so learners drill non-words and obscure terms
Finished..symptom: Samples from the shipped public/dictionary.txt: aaa, aah, aahed, aardwolves, levulic, levynite, leviticus.
Finished..fix: OPEN. Cap the fill by a frequency floor, drop proper nouns and chemical names, and run the NSFW filter over the whole file before it ships.

Finished..title: Admin day-bucketing uses toISOString so activity lands on the wrong calendar day outside UTC
Finished..symptom: Per-day admin counts shift by a day for local evenings/mornings.
Finished..fix: OPEN (low). Bucket with local year/month/date parts or an explicit timezone.

Finished..title: Assistant claims success for no-op actions on Pro
Finished..symptom: On Pro, asking the assistant to add a milestone, start a timer or invite a teammate created nothing yet it did not fail honestly (or returned the wrong hour).
Finished..fix: Corrected the action wiring/reporting so it no longer claims success for nothing.

Finished..title: Celebration inline edits not saving
Finished..symptom: Editing celebrations directly on the main screen didn't work.
Finished..fix: Fixed the main-screen celebration edit path so edits apply.

Finished..title: Could sign up without choosing a plan/price
Finished..symptom: Signup completed without the user selecting a price.
Finished..fix: Required a plan pick during signup.

Finished..title: Countdown count-up broken
Finished..symptom: Birthday/anniversary countdowns didn't count down or up correctly.
Finished..fix: Fixed count-up and added days+hours, dd/mm/yyyy dates, and a repeats-every-year toggle.

Finished..title: Credit price mismatch between display and checkout
Finished..symptom: The app showed $19 for 100 credits while checkout charged $50, and two credit tiles 404'd.
Finished..fix: Introduced a canonical credits.ts tier table used everywhere so display matches checkout ($19 = 100 credits).

Finished..title: Day/Night toggle did not actually flip themes
Finished..symptom: Switching the Day/Night toggle did not reliably change modes.
Finished..fix: Separated Midnight from dark mode so the Day/Night toggle now flips correctly.

Finished..title: Dictionary cache kept an Urban Dictionary entry under the old provider order, and one transient Wiktionary failure made real words fall through to slang
Finished..symptom: 'percent' showed a slang definition after the provider chain was corrected.
Finished..fix: Add CACHE_VERSION (bumped to 2 then 3) so old entries are ignored, and retry the provider once before falling through.

Finished..title: Doc links from Projects and the Home starred strip dropped the document id and opened the Write list
Finished..symptom: Clicking a doc attached to a Project, or a starred doc chip on Home, landed on the Write gallery instead of that document. Notes also could not be starred at all.
Finished..fix: Thread onOpenDoc(id) through App to Library and call setView({name:'writing', openId:id}); add 'note' to the Star union.

Finished..title: Duplicate SlotEditor block in Scheduler edit
Finished..symptom: Scheduler edit rendered a duplicated slot editor.
Finished..fix: Removed the stray duplicate block.

Finished..title: Editors defaulted to the V2 design while create() wrote V1, so existing and seeded items opened in the wrong version
Finished..symptom: Docs, sheets, to-dos and the scheduler opened as V2 even when saved as V1.
Finished..fix: Default to the stored value and fall back to v2 only for an explicit v2.

Finished..title: Empty Clipboard click did nothing
Finished..symptom: Clicking the Clipboard section when it was empty produced no response.
Finished..fix: Made the Clipboard render and respond even when empty.

Finished..title: Exam word decks shared one generic bank, so SAT showed 'dead' and 'cat' and MCAT/LSAT/GMAT received literary words
Finished..symptom: A SAT card read 'dead' (user-caught); MCAT and LSAT decks contained literary vocabulary; one bundled word had a stray leading space (' contingent').
Finished..fix: Rebuild per-test decks from researched profiles (SAT/ACT in-context academic, MCAT science, LSAT logic and legal, GMAT business, GRE the obscure tail, shared AWL core); trim the stray space. ielts/toefl keep common words because they test general English.

Finished..title: First-run onboarding never opened under React StrictMode because the 'seen' flag was set before the timeout that opens it
Finished..symptom: Goal setup did not auto-open for new users and never would again (flag already set to 1).
Finished..fix: Write the flag inside the timeout callback, immediately before opening the modal.

Finished..title: Google Translate silently returned untranslated text
Finished..symptom: Live Google Translate did not actually translate in the UI.
Finished..fix: Made the client call the Supabase function first and skip the no-key echo, and made Supabase translate read the key from the Vault.

Finished..title: Handle-availability indicator showed a stale result
Finished..symptom: The username handle checker showed a stale ✓ available against a name that was actually taken.
Finished..fix: Fixed the stale state and added an authoritative re-check on submit.

Finished..title: Insert-table button could not add rows or columns
Finished..symptom: In docs, the insert-table feature didn't let users add rows and columns.
Finished..fix: Wired the table popover to add rows/columns.

Finished..title: Mic re-captures tab audio (echo)
Finished..symptom: Recordings had echo from the mic picking up the tab's own audio.
Finished..fix: Applied the researched echo fix to the audio routing.

Finished..title: Milestone back-dating did not change the 'N days since' count
Finished..symptom: Editing the date of a milestone left '5 days since' unchanged
Finished..fix: startedAt made the single editable source and achievedAt separately editable; 'X days ago' computed from achievedAt; verified day 6 then day 41 after editing to 40 days ago (fixed in the Hallalu port; the Finished. original still carries the bug)

Finished..title: Milestone category dropdown did not offer newly added categories (stale closure over the cats array)
Finished..symptom: A category added in Milestones never appeared in the milestone form dropdown
Finished..fix: categories read through one accessor (myCats()) and updated functionally; verified the new category appears in the dropdown and manager (fixed in the Hallalu port only)

Finished..title: Monthly free AI credits were never granted: my_credits() only gave a one-time +5 welcome
Finished..symptom: A free user who spent the welcome credits stayed at 0 forever although the plan copy promised a monthly allowance.
Finished..fix: Migration 20260817_monthly_free_credits.sql adds ensure_monthly_free(), called lazily from my_credits(): reason 'monthly-free:YYYY-MM', a partial unique index on (user_id, reason) where reason like 'monthly-free:%', insert ... on conflict do nothing and bump the balance only when a row was inserted; skipped in a month that already has a welcome or renewal grant. Verified live on two users, idempotent.

Finished..title: New accounts got the 'Close friends' circle added twice
Finished..symptom: A new account had two 'Close friends' circles seeded.
Finished..fix: Made seeding idempotent (select + limit(1)) plus a DB unique index, and cleaned the existing duplicate.

Finished..title: New dictionary APIs worked on the dev server but production CSP connect-src blocked them, so meanings and IPA would have failed live
Finished..symptom: Found in a self-audit before release: every third-party dictionary fetch would be refused in production.
Finished..fix: Add each origin to connect-src and test third-party fetches under a production-CSP preview (vite preview) instead of dev.

Finished..title: NLP leaves attendee name in event title
Finished..symptom: 'Priya' stayed in the event title instead of becoming a guest chip.
Finished..fix: Fixed the parser so the attendee is extracted into a guest chip.

Finished..title: Notes format buttons (checkbox, bullet, number) appended the marker to the END of the text while typing inserted at the caret
Finished..symptom: Tapping a format button mid-note put the marker at the bottom, scrambling the note; typed markers landed in the right place.
Finished..fix: Keep a textarea ref, insert at selectionStart and restore the caret with setSelectionRange inside requestAnimationFrame.

Finished..title: Page doesn't translate on language change
Finished..symptom: Switching the language didn't translate the page.
Finished..fix: Implemented a whole-page auto-translator; verified English->French/Spanish with name and brand preserved.

Finished..title: PDF cover-title letter-spacing extraction
Finished..symptom: Letter-spaced PDF cover lines were mangled (e.g. "H A L L A L U / I N T E L L I G E N C E") and text was read out letter-by-letter instead of as whole words.
Finished..fix: Added per-line gap statistics (median x1.6), a collapse-regex safeguard, font-size heading detection with multi-line merge, and running-header removal.

Finished..title: Sheet formulas only understood =SUM and =AVERAGE over a range, so the Budget template could not compute left-over
Finished..symptom: Cell references and arithmetic (=B2-C2, =A1*2) showed as text or errors.
Finished..fix: Replace with a small recursive-descent parser (cell refs, + - * /, parentheses, SUM/AVERAGE) with a cycle guard.

Finished..title: Six milestone module bugs
Finished..symptom: Six reported milestone bugs affected the milestones feature.
Finished..fix: Fixed all six milestone bugs at their root causes, each verified.

Finished..title: Speaking a whole day produced ONE timetable block, could not be edited, and ignored the current time
Finished..symptom: Dictation and pasted lists became a single block; the transcript could not be edited afterwards; spoken times that had already passed were still placed in the past.
Finished..fix: 'Speak your day' opens an editable review (Speak, Pause, Resume, Done, live split preview). New splitter: task starters ('I need to'), connectives (then, after that, also), soft ' and ' with a food safelist ('fish and chips'), commas, each fresh clock time or range, plus a verb-boundary splitter for 'read a book do the laundry call grandma'. Spoken number words become digits only in time contexts; intro phrases ('so today I'm hoping to') are stripped repeatedly; times already past roll to now.

Finished..title: Split translation strings produced garbled copy
Finished..symptom: Translated sign-in copy came out garbled, e.g. 'Choisissez un 5Code PIN à 8 chiffres', and a card embedded the language name mid-sentence.
Finished..fix: Made each phrase a single string so it translates as one unit, and stopped embedding the language name mid-sentence.

Finished..title: Themed word levels reached their headline counts by borrowing generic words: Travel contained 'able, about, above' and Money & finance is still padded
Finished..symptom: 'Travel & place names' showed 3,865 words but only about 560 were places or travel terms; Finance shows 2,012 with the same padding.
Finished..fix: Travel: dropped the shared banks and grew real world place and metro names to 1,087. Finance is still padded (OPEN, owner chose Travel only). The honest section audit (real 'full suite' sizes per exam) is the pattern to keep.

Finished..title: Time-cue splitter orphaned 'pm' and split 'from 2 to 4' into two tasks (regex backtracking)
Finished..symptom: Results like [study from 2, to 4] and [dinner at 7, pm] appeared in the test table; found before shipping.
Finished..fix: Add a negative lookahead for a following 'to/till/until/through N' range and for am/pm after the cue; keep 'buy 3 apples' from being treated as a time. Cover with the fixture table (run-on, no-time, ranges, bare times, food safelist, digits that are not times).

Finished..title: To-do 'Top 3 focus' label was cosmetic: it highlighted the first three rows by index
Finished..symptom: Users could not choose their focus items; reordering or completing rows silently changed which three were called focus.
Finished..fix: Add TodoItem.focus (capped at 3) and urgency, plus drag reorder, and render the eyebrow from the flag.

Finished..title: Tracker empty-state showed 'under a minute' instead of '0 min'
Finished..symptom: With zero tracked time, the Tracker showed 'under a minute' (x3) rather than 0 min.
Finished..fix: Added if (totalMinutes === 0) return '0 min' before the 'under a minute' branch.

Finished..title: Transcription not in the user's language
Finished..symptom: Voice transcription didn't produce text in the user's selected language.
Finished..fix: Added a transcription-in-your-language fix alongside many more UI languages.

Finished..title: Translate batch cap regression dropped half of each batch
Finished..symptom: Legitimate localization batches would silently lose half their strings.
Finished..fix: Raised the server per-request string ceiling to 128 in both the Supabase and Cloudflare versions.

Finished..title: UI strings (toasts, doc names) stayed in English when translating
Finished..symptom: After switching language, many words stayed in English including toast messages and document names.
Finished..fix: Wired showToast and other strings through the translation system with new i18n keys so translation propagates app-wide.

Finished..title: Vault API key saved with trailing space
Finished..symptom: AI features would silently break after wiring up the key.
Finished..fix: Corrected/normalized the secret name so the key is read correctly.

Finished..title: Whitelist paste sanitiser dropped bold and italic when unwrapping Google Docs spans
Finished..symptom: Pasting Google Docs content lost all emphasis even though the user chose to keep bold and italic. Browser test showed boldPreserved false.
Finished..fix: Before unwrapping a span or font element, read its style and re-wrap the children in <strong> or <em>, while still dropping colours, fonts and other inline styles. Verified: bold and italic preserved, no style attributes remain.

Hallalu CRM.title: OPEN: public write endpoints rely on a per-isolate in-memory rate limiter

Hallalu CRM.fix: Not fixed: use a D1 counter or a Durable Object / the Workers rate-limit binding for public writes and expensive AI routes.

Hallalu CRM.title: Owner email exposed client-side in admin.js

Hallalu CRM.fix: Moved the owner email/admin check server-side.

Hallalu CRM.title: Private investor deck gate was decorative: //_pitch.html and /%5Fpitch.html returned the whole deck and deck.js (34KB) was a public asset

Hallalu CRM.title: Standalone meeting-card link carries its whole model unsigned in the URL fragment, and the logo URL falls back to the raw value when safeUrl rejects it
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Anyone can hand-craft portal.html?card=1#<base64 JSON> and have the app's own origin render an official-looking 'You're booked in' card with arbitrary title, location, add-to-calendar link, logo image and email-collect form.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Not fixed in this batch. Recommended: HMAC-sign the card snapshot or register it server-side as /api/portal/register already does for pid portals, and drop the ||d.logo fallback.

Hallalu CRM.title: Stored XSS in the public proposal-accept page title
Hallalu CRM.symptom: A proposal titled with </title><script>… executed when a client opened the public /accept link
Hallalu CRM.fix: Escaped the title/from values consistently with the body; also added nosniff / X-Frame-Options / Referrer-Policy to the public HTML responses

Hallalu CRM.title: The _headers CSP never reached the app shell because the Worker builds those responses itself, and the policy had to be pasted into six response sites
Hallalu CRM.symptom: After adding Content-Security-Policy and nosniff, framing and referrer headers to public/_headers, the landing page and /app (answered by the Worker through run_worker_first) kept their hand-written header sets with no CSP; six Worker HTML responses each carried their own copy of the headers
Hallalu CRM.fix: Define the policy once as a shared constant and apply it through one helper used by every Worker HTML response, then verify the live response headers on both / and /app (done for six sites; the helper is still open)

Hallalu CRM.title: Unfurl SSRF guard checks hostname only and follows redirects: DNS rebinding and redirect-to-internal bypass
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The paste-a-link unfurl rejects obvious private hostnames but a public hostname that resolves to a private IP, or a public URL that 302s to an internal address, passes the guard.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Use redirect:'manual' and re-validate each Location, block private/loopback/link-local ranges after resolution where possible, cap size and time, and strip response headers. Documented; hardening still open.

Hallalu CRM.title: Anything kept under S.ui is lost on reload because save() destructures ui away (third incident: chosen theme)
Hallalu CRM.symptom: A named theme chosen in Settings reverted after a reload. The same root cause had already wiped a running work timer on refresh and the selected call lead (the calls screen then showed another company's history).
Hallalu CRM.fix: bgTheme moved to S.settings (persisted); live timers are persisted under a liveTimers key and restored by resumeTimers; the call lead is persisted. House rule: S.ui is ephemeral view state only, any user-chosen setting belongs in S.settings.

Hallalu CRM.title: Invoice builder wipes line items on every repaint
Hallalu CRM.symptom: 'Add a line' did nothing and invoices could not be saved.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Separated initialization from repaint so line items persist, and corrected the maths.

Hallalu CRM.title: Opening a picker modal from inside a form wiped the parent form
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Opening the currency picker from inside New-lead / Settings / Invoice destroyed the parent modal and every value already typed into it
Hallalu CRM.fix: Rewrote openCurPick as its own stacked overlay (z-index above the parent modal) that closes only itself, leaving the form intact

Hallalu CRM.title: Portal editor deletes were one-click with no confirmation for nine releases (house rule: delete-confirm)
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Clicking the remove control on a manual update, step, task, phase or deliverable removed it instantly (a phase went from 1 to 0, a timeline row from 8 to 7). The user had to ask again for delete confirmations.
Hallalu CRM.fix: askDel() wraps confirmDel (Keep it / Yes, delete) and re-opens the editor; every portal remove now uses it.

Hallalu CRM.title: Several destructive deletes ran with no confirmation (logged social action, team post, tax payment, cadence/calendar sub-events)
Hallalu CRM.symptom: One tap on delete removed a logged social action, a team wall post or a recorded tax payment (which also puts the 'still held' figure back) with no undo or prompt, while core deletes (lead, project, todo, note) already confirmed.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Wrap social-act-del, team-post-del and tx-del in confirmDel with a plain-English consequence line; sweep every data-act ending in -del for a confirm.

Hallalu CRM.title: /api/track throws TDZ from duplicate
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The `/api/track` endpoint threw a temporal-dead-zone error.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Removed the duplicate; endpoint works.

Hallalu CRM.title: Admin check crashes for signed-out users
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The app would crash for signed-out visitors.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Added a null guard.

Hallalu CRM.title: Calendar view crashed on any event kind not in KINDS (new 'focus'/'personal' events, .ics import, hand-edited record)
Hallalu CRM.symptom: TypeError reading 'color' of undefined at calendar.js:176 took the whole calendar view down
Hallalu CRM.fix: single lookup with neutral fallback at all five sites; Ava's add_event constrained to valid kinds

Hallalu CRM.title: Hallucinated Stripe checkout APIs
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Checkout would have failed the instant real keys were added.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Rewrote to the real Embedded Checkout API and correct version header (four fixes).

Hallalu CRM.title: Signup returned Cloudflare HTML 500 'Worker threw exception' — PBKDF2 at 210,000 iterations exceeds the Workers cap
Hallalu CRM.symptom: POST /api/auth/signup returned a Cloudflare error page (content-type text/html) instead of JSON; sign-up, sign-in and every auth test failed and wrangler tail showed no logged exception
Hallalu CRM.fix: ITER lowered to 100_000 and an HMAC 'pepper' (PASS_PEPPER secret) layered over the derived bits as the compensating control; 15/15 backend checks then passed

Hallalu CRM.title: AI assistant could execute Business-tier actions (milestones, timers, team invites) on a Pro plan
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Plan awareness existed only as UI gating helpers; Ava's action layer would create Business data for lower plans
Hallalu CRM.fix: ava-more.js wraps doAvaAction with a plan-requirement map; refusals return an explanation plus the free-week offer (or upgrade once the week is used); calendar still allowed on Pro

Hallalu CRM.title: Custom business types and asset categories users type are sent to the server as telemetry events and listed by name in the admin panel
Hallalu CRM.symptom: A 'What users are adding' admin panel shows each custom label a user typed, grouped with counts; the tracker's own header promises it never captures anything typed
Hallalu CRM.fix: Open: send a hashed or bucketed label only, or let the user opt in to share a category name, and update the tracker contract and privacy copy to match

Hallalu CRM.title: No privacy policy and no delete-my-data path although accounts store personal data (flagged, not fixed)
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Users can create accounts and store contacts and call notes but nothing explains processing or lets them erase their data.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Publish a privacy policy and add a delete-account control that erases D1 rows and R2 objects (GDPR Art. 17) with an export first.

Hallalu CRM.title: OPEN: client-portal privacy filter keys on a title regex because internal follow-up reminders carry no marker
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Auto-generated reminders are stored as kind:'todo' with a title 'Follow up <name> - <label>'. The portal hides them with /^follow up/i, which also hides a legitimate meeting called 'Follow-up call' and would leak a reminder if the title format ever changed or the owner renamed one.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Not fixed: stamp internal:true (or src:'followup') on the event when it is created and filter on that.

Hallalu CRM.title: A versioned asset URL (calm.js?v=38) returned 0 bytes right after deploy and stayed cached, leaving the feature undefined until a cache:reload
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Straight after a wrangler deploy the page loaded index.html with the calm.js tag but window.calmStart was undefined with no console error; fetching /calm.js?v=38 returned length 0.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Bump ?v= again and redeploy and re-fetch with {cache:'reload'}; add a post-deploy check that each new asset has non-zero length (curl -s URL | wc -c) before declaring the deploy verified.

Hallalu CRM.title: Cloud autosave silently dropped writes made during an in-flight push, then raised a false 'changed somewhere else' conflict on a single device
Hallalu CRM.symptom: 14 rapid saves lost the last several; the conflict dialog appeared with only one device in use
Hallalu CRM.fix: serialise pushes (dirty flag plus immediate re-push on completion), remember revs the client itself produced and adopt them on 409; genuine second-device writes still raise the conflict

Hallalu CRM.title: New demo seed data never reaches existing demo sessions (user saw an 'older version' and the session blamed a stale deploy)
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The user said the demo 'shows an older version'. Seed edits (Glossier to Sephora, ecommerce types/affiliate/photos) were invisible on any browser that had opened the demo before.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Version the seed (S.demoSeedV) and migrate or re-seed when it changes.

Hallalu CRM.title: Stale HTML shell served from cache
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The browser kept serving a stale index.html, making fixes look broken for testers and real users.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Made the shell never cache so deploys are picked up immediately.

Hallalu CRM.title: App never signed the user in: bootAccount scheduled on setTimeout(0) before the next script was fetched
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Valid session cookie and /api/auth/me returning the full user, yet S.account stayed null on every page load (silent, no console error)
Hallalu CRM.fix: removed the timer from app.js; wire.js (last script, owner of the function) calls bootAccount() at the end of its own execution

Hallalu CRM.title: 'Do next' sorted only by due date: a new action set for 3 days sank to the bottom and 'Today' could not be chosen
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The user added a next action and it landed at the bottom of the list; the New follow-up modal offered Tomorrow as the earliest option.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Bucket overdue, then today, then upcoming; within today the newest action first; save-followup stamps next.setAt; a Today chip was added. Verified in the live Do-next view.

Hallalu CRM.title: 'New call' button did nothing: duplicate case 'new-call' in one switch, the first case shadowed the real modal
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Button click only reset the recorder; the New call modal at the bottom of the switch was unreachable dead code
Hallalu CRM.fix: first renamed to 'reset-recorder'; grep -o "case '...':" | sort | uniq -d used to look for other duplicates

Hallalu CRM.title: 'Say a first hello' prompt stayed after a call was logged
Hallalu CRM.symptom: A lead that had just been called remained in 'To reach out' with the first-hello prompt.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Any logged call attempt sets firstTouch and moves new to messaged (never downgrading a later stage). Verified on a new-stage lead: it moved to the waiting bucket and the prompt disappeared. Note this also treats a no-answer attempt as a contact attempt.

Hallalu CRM.title: A contact with only a business name could not be saved (add-lead demanded a name, handle or phone)
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Entering just a Business name and pressing Add to pipeline showed the 'give them a name or handle' toast and saved nothing.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Add nlBiz to the fallback chain (name, business, handle, phone) and update the toast; verified a lead 'Test Biz Co' saves with an empty name.

Hallalu CRM.title: Ava (LLM assistant) created reminders and company goals in the past (2024/2025) because the model did the date arithmetic
Hallalu CRM.symptom: 'Remind me next Tuesday' stored 2025-01-07 and 'by December' stored 2024-12-31 while today was 30 Jul 2026, so the to-do never appears; the first fix (pull past dates forward) produced 2027-01-07
Hallalu CRM.fix: model now passes the user's own phrase ('next tuesday', 'in 3 days'); dayOf() resolves it deterministically in code and clamps any past ISO date to the next occurrence; prompt states the current year

Hallalu CRM.title: Ava voice command stopped at the first pause, and the live transcript silently broke after the composer redesign
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Dictating to Ava ended at the first breath, cutting long commands. After the composer redesign the live 'heard' text stopped updating with no error.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Continuous capture with accumulation and restart-on-end guarded by a stop flag; the ids were restored.

Hallalu CRM.title: Billing view shows outdated Solo/Studio/£19 pricing
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The billing/pricing view still displayed the old Solo/Studio tiers with a £19 price even for the free plan (the 'free 19 pounds' bug).
Hallalu CRM.fix: Rewrote the billing view to USD flat pricing with free=$0 and stripped the pricing promises.

Hallalu CRM.title: Blended valuation dragged the low end down to the asset floor, showing $19,600 to $144,000 for a $96,000 to $144,000 earnings range
Hallalu CRM.symptom: After three assets were logged the hero range fell to a low of $19,600 although the earnings lens said $96,000 to $144,000
Hallalu CRM.fix: Lift the low and high to the floor only when net asset value exceeds them, and test the three cases (floor below, inside and above the range, e.g. a $200,000 building lifting the range to $219,600)

Hallalu CRM.title: Call recap invents bullets and ignores the transcript
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The grounded-outreach call recap showed hardcoded bullets (e.g. 'Friday'/'mockup') instead of anything from the actual call.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Grounded the recap in the real transcript with a non-inventing fallback so the key points come from the user's own words.

Hallalu CRM.title: CTA keyword regex without the i flag missed a capitalised comment keyword
Hallalu CRM.symptom: A post using Comment SEATING was not recognised as a call to action although the lowercase form was.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Use the i flag (and normalise whitespace) for every user-facing keyword matcher and add a capitalised case to the test list.

Hallalu CRM.title: Currency search fails on plurals and place names
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Typing terms like 'dollars', 'trinidad' or 'america' into the currency search returned no match.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Made curSearch stem trailing plurals so plural and related terms resolve to the right currency.

Hallalu CRM.title: Date handling produced the wrong year
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Goal/close dates resolved to the wrong year (e.g. 2024, and 'next Tuesday' became 2027).
Hallalu CRM.fix: Fixed date computation generally so relative dates resolve to the correct year.

Hallalu CRM.title: Dead route after creating a project while viewing a client
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Creating a project while viewing a client left the user on a dead route.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Corrected the post-creation navigation so it lands on a valid view.

Hallalu CRM.title: Delete actions silently do nothing
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Several delete controls appeared to work but deleted nothing.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Fixed the deletes and added delete-confirmations everywhere.

Hallalu CRM.title: Deliverable Approve button shows 'Approved' even when the POST fails, and stores an approval as an open request
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The assistant noted 'the approve POST will actually 404 silently, but the UI will still show the Approved feedback - that's fine'. On a link whose pid is not registered (owner signed out, never published, or a transient failure) the client sees confirmation and the owner receives nothing. When it does post, the approval arrives as kind='request' status='open' and needs 'Mark done'.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Not fixed: show success only on ok:true, hide Approve when no thread is registered, and give approvals their own kind. Never exercised end to end ('proven by transitivity').

Hallalu CRM.title: Demo comms/leads didn't seed
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The demo's communications/leads didn't appear because they were never seeded.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Fixed the demo seed path so demo leads/comms populate.

Hallalu CRM.title: Demo seed edits never reach returning visitors: decorateDemo only fills missing fields and demo state is cached in localStorage
Hallalu CRM.symptom: After swapping the demo portraits the live demo still showed the old stock photos; only localStorage.clear() revealed the change. Seeding a new demo meeting had the same limitation.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Verified each change by clearing storage and reloading with a fresh query. The durable fix (a demoSeedVersion stamp compared on boot to re-decorate or re-seed) was not shipped in this session.

Hallalu CRM.title: Demo showed empty Activity and Milestones, and the first milestone seed used the wrong record shape
Hallalu CRM.symptom: In the demo the Activity timeline and Milestones views were empty, so a visitor could not see two business features that exist.

Hallalu CRM.title: Demo shows wrong base currency
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The UK demo displayed USD instead of GBP.

Hallalu CRM.title: Demo tier gating honoured the signed-in account's plan, so a Pro user exploring the Business demo saw locked features
Hallalu CRM.symptom: With a real Pro account signed in, the demo (meant to show every Business feature) still reported myPlan()='pro' and hasPlan('business')=false, so Business screens were locked inside the demo.
Hallalu CRM.fix: window.myPlan = () => S.demo ? 'business' : (S.account?.plan || S.user.plan || 'free'); verified the demo reports business for signed-in explorers too.

Hallalu CRM.title: Dialer dropped the contact's role: leadNumbers read pr.role but the contact form stores pr.title
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Numbers belonging to additional people on a client showed no role label in the dialer.
Hallalu CRM.fix: leadNumbers reads pr.title with pr.role as fallback and now sorts the starred main number first (a main-number star was added to the contact block and honoured by the dialer and WhatsApp).

Hallalu CRM.title: Duplicate global definitions silently shadow each other: clientMeetingsCard in two files, two case 'mark-sent' labels, two onboarding flows
Hallalu CRM.symptom: A new client-page Meetings card was written, deployed and 'verified' present in the source, yet never rendered because projects.js (loaded later) already defines window.clientMeetingsCard; a second case 'mark-sent' in the same switch was dead code; a copy edit to the sign-up name placeholder landed in signin.js while app.js renders the live onboarding.

Rule: grep for window.<name> = and case '<act>' across public/*.js before adding.

Hallalu CRM.title: Ecom 'By channel' breakdown labelled every channel 'Other' because channel ids did not match platform keys
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The by-channel list in the ecommerce hub showed 'Other' for every row.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Add platOf(key) that resolves a channel id to its platform (or treats the key as a platform) and use it in grouping, order rows and badges.

Hallalu CRM.title: Editing a lead can't set Google/Maps source
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Google/Maps couldn't be chosen when editing a lead, and demo leads were mislabeled call/email.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Switched the edit form to the full source picker and corrected the demo leads.

Hallalu CRM.title: Element chips and DM-template chips in Socials did nothing (click delegate only matched [data-act])
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Format/element chips (data-sq-el), the Wave-8 DM template chips (data-dm-tpl) and copy buttons (data-dm-copy) never toggled or loaded. It shipped for about one wave.

Hallalu CRM.title: Fixing the retired Gemini model default in code had no effect because a GEMINI_MODEL secret overrode it
Hallalu CRM.symptom: After changing the default from gemini-2.0-flash (retired, 404) to a current model and redeploying, /api/ai still returned 'model no longer available'; the deployed secret pinned the retired model.

Hallalu CRM.title: Free-tier call recap emailed the raw transcript back as the 'professional' follow-up
Hallalu CRM.symptom: After a recorded call the follow-up email and short-message boxes held the pasted raw transcript instead of a written recap; the user said the notes were not professional.

Hallalu CRM.title: Google-Maps paste parser took the category line as the lead's city
Hallalu CRM.symptom: After pasting four Maps results, one lead's city read 'Roofing Supply Shop' instead of the real city.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Tighten the fallback: skip rating/category lines and only accept a city from the address line or an explicit 'City, ST' pattern.

Hallalu CRM.title: Hardcoded '3.1×' caption
Hallalu CRM.symptom: A '3.1×' caption was displayed as if computed but was hardcoded.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Corrected the caption for honesty rather than hardcoding it.

Hallalu CRM.title: Header clock and weather chip showed the device's time, not the chosen city's, and ambiguous city names mis-geocoded
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Choosing London on a US device still showed Eastern time in the chip. Typing a bare city name such as Manchester or London could resolve to the wrong place.

Hallalu CRM.title: Landing 'See the demo' buttons opened /app, so after the blank-start change visitors saw empty onboarding instead of the demo
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The owner clicked 'See the demo' on the public landing and did not get the populated demo she had been testing.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Point both demo links to /app?demo=1; verified by fingerprinting the demo reached via the landing click against a direct /app?demo=1 load (IDENTICAL).

Hallalu CRM.title: Landing 'See the demo' silently dropped returning visitors into their real free-plan session, and the fix was deployed before the data-safety path was tested
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The user could not see the business parts in the demo. /app?demo=1 only started the demo if (!S.onboarded), so anyone who had used the app before stayed in their real session where business views are walled. Hallalu CRM.fix: Stash-and-restore with a restore button and 'Start my own' clearing the stash; verified restore by clicking the real button. Project-scoped data and signed-in sync remain unproven.

Hallalu CRM.title: Landing page silently redirects onboarded users to /app
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The deployed landing page at / was never visible to onboarded users because it silently bounced them to /app.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Fixed the redirect (adding an ?app override) so the landing page is reachable.

Hallalu CRM.title: Local 'pct' variable shadows global pct() function
Hallalu CRM.symptom: A percentage calculation misbehaved due to name collision.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Renamed the shadowing local variable to remove the collision.

Hallalu CRM.title: Marking an invoice paid (or Ava log_payment) never wrote the payment to the client's own story
Hallalu CRM.symptom: A paid invoice updated invoices and the money totals, but the client page, timeline and payment history showed nothing.
Hallalu CRM.fix: One logClientPayment() writes lead.payments + a timeline money entry + S.money; mark-paid was inlined onto it so a payment is not counted twice.

Hallalu CRM.title: NaN% reply rate and non-zero outreach on empty project
Hallalu CRM.symptom: An empty project showed NaN% for reply rate and a fresh project did not start its outreach count at 0.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Removed the NaN and made a fresh project start outreach count at 0.

Hallalu CRM.title: One booked meeting rendered two or three times in Today > Meetings
Hallalu CRM.symptom: A meeting auto-booked from a call appeared up to three times with slightly different titles.
Hallalu CRM.fix: De-duplicate on leadId plus minute (Math.round(ts/60000)) instead of title. Verified: six rows collapsed to two, and a clean demo shows one row.

Hallalu CRM.title: OPEN: back-dated posts are stamped at 12:00 local, polluting the best-time heatmap
Hallalu CRM.symptom: After adding a 'When posted' date, every back-dated post lands in the noon bucket of the personal best-time (day x hour) heatmap. Before that, the heatmap used the time the action was logged as a proxy for post time.

Hallalu CRM.title: OPEN: budget total on the client-facing page read 86.48 while the snapshot said $648; dismissed without investigation
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The Delivery-portal snapshot reported spent '$648'; the rendered client page showed a total of '86.48'. The assistant wrote 'possibly just a formatting or rendering quirk I shouldn't fixate on' and moved on.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Not fixed: compare d.budget.spent with the rendered text and check the money() formatting/rounding path.

Hallalu CRM.title: OPEN: owner's own preview inflates the portal 'viewed N times' counter

Hallalu CRM.title: OPEN: social goals mix a derived done flag written inside render() with a day-based goals system
Hallalu CRM.symptom: After saving a social goal, done:0 stayed stale until the Overview tab rendered. The main Goals view filters day===today, so period-based social targets do not fit it. Editing a social goal in the generic goalModal would strip its metric linkage.

Hallalu CRM.title: Outcome picker forced after every recorded call although the transcript already says what happened
Hallalu CRM.symptom: After recording, typing notes and tapping submit, the app still asked what kind of call it was and whether they answered.
Hallalu CRM.fix: endCall skips the picker when at least 25 characters of real speech exist and calls summariseCall with auto:true; the recap prompt returns the outcome enum, a tidied transcript and any meeting as JSON; the recap shows the inferred outcome as an editable select and a change rewrites the logged attempt. Hallalu CRM.title: Paste importer mis-parses co.uk domains
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Pasted leads with `.co.uk` sites and business domains were parsed wrong (domain treated as email).

Hallalu CRM.title: Paste importer treats a whole Google Maps paste as one lead

Hallalu CRM.fix: Reworked the importer so a run-together paste splits into individual leads (via the AI-split path) instead of one block.

Hallalu CRM.title: Phone-number parser misreads across lines
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Phone parsing failed on multi-line input and numbers with a leading parenthesis.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Rewrote the phone pattern to stay on one line and allow a leading paren.

Hallalu CRM.title: Plans page prefixed GBP amounts with a hard-coded dollar sign (customers saw $15/month for a £15 price)
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The pricing view showed $15 / $25 / $50 while the Stripe prices behind the buttons were GBP, so the displayed currency did not match what checkout would charge.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Add a per-currency price table that must match scripts/setup-stripe.mjs and drive display and checkout currency from the same selection (later switched to USD-only with Stripe localising at checkout).

Hallalu CRM.title: Plus price lived in four places; the UI said $18 while the real Stripe charge path still said $15, and a changed amount could never take effect
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Asked to change Plus to $18, the assistant edited two sources, deployed, and a browser check showed the Plus card still at '$13/month' (the old 150/12). It committed 'across all 3 sources' and told the user Stripe prices follow the same numbers 'automatically'. That was false: src/stripe.js has its own PLAN_USD at [15,150]. Between the v183 deploy and the later fix, the page advertised $18 on a path that charged $15.
Hallalu CRM.fix: PLAN_USD to [18,180] and an amount-aware lookup_key (hallalu_plus_m_18 / hallalu_plus_y_180) so a price change mints a fresh Price; existing subscribers keep their price; entitlement falls back to subscription metadata.plan. Listed secret names only and confirmed no PRICE_PLUS_* ids are pinned (so the deployment auto-mints), then proved the 1800/18000 unit_amount payload by computing it. The four copies are still hand-mirrored.

Hallalu CRM.title: Read-aloud reply and button do nothing
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The assistant's reply did not speak and the read-aloud button after the fact did nothing.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Fixed both halves so replies speak and the button works.

Hallalu CRM.title: Trial→paid KPI shows NaN%

Hallalu CRM.fix: Corrected the precedence so the KPI computes a real percentage.

Hallalu CRM.title: Pricing page wedge and stats bank shipped two unverifiable statistics: HoneyBook '+89% price rise' (AI affiliate SEO folklore) and '21x more likely to qualify within 5 minutes' (2007 vendor deck histogram ratio)
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Pricing page and deck asserted an 89% overnight hike that HoneyBook's live pricing contradicts; the 21x figure is a ratio of histogram bars (12,700/1,190) with no denominator
Hallalu CRM.fix: both removed; replaced with Xero invoice data (28.8 days, 32,000+ businesses), IRS Data Book FY2025 and a 2025 Hennessey Digital response-time audit; speed-to-lead concept restored with HBR 2011 (1.25M leads) after the critic was verified

Hallalu CRM.title: Real TikTok/Instagram effect names deleted because a research lane 'could not verify' them while its search tools were blocked
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Time Warp Scan, Inverted, Speed ramp, Bling and Superzoom were removed from the effects suggestions. The user called it out: a critique is a claim too, and do not invent a restriction.
Hallalu CRM.fix: All five verified real (TikTok effect page, trending pages, Effect House docs, Instagram camera) and restored with a code comment recording why; lesson saved.

Hallalu CRM.title: Requested portal behaviours were dropped or reduced but reported as done
Hallalu CRM.symptom: (1) Emoji pulse: the user chose 'private by default, toggle for the client to see'; only private shipped and the report says 'private to you' with no mention of the missing toggle. (2) 'emails and see when they have viewed it like Canva': email-open tracking was skipped, and the report says 'view tracking tells you when they opened'. (4) Widgets 'with the real icon': first built as emoji and reported as 'real icons'; real brand SVGs only arrived after the user complained again ('not the camera logo').
Hallalu CRM.fix: Not fixed for 1-3: add the client-visible pulse toggle, an always-visible portal entry on Today, and label page views as page views. Item 4 fixed in v181.

Hallalu CRM.title: Several shipped research claims were wrong by domain transfer or overreach (portal adoption, Etsy template ban, follow-up counts, filter stats)
Hallalu CRM.symptom: A counter-evidence audit caught: the '23% client-portal adoption' figure (Fraccaro et al 2017) is about healthcare patient portals, headline 52% with a 13-33% CI dropped; the Etsy 'template ban was a misreading' note was too strong (a real June 2025 Creativity Standards change removed the templated-design clause for computerised tools); the debunk of '5-7 follow-ups' overreached (the source said fifth to twelfth contact, a small 1942 sample); the '21% more views for filtered photos' stat is a Flickr study (Bakhshi et al 2015), widely miscited as Instagram.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Research file corrected (no credible freelancer-portal figure exists), memory corrected, filter stat reattributed.

Hallalu CRM.title: The shipped Instagram signal claim ranked sends above saves and likes though its source named three unranked signals, and the 2026 re-check fixed only one constant
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Copy said shares/sends are Instagram's most heavily weighted signal, above saves and likes, labelled FACT; the 2026 re-verify found it is surface-specific (sends win for non-followers on Reels, likes edge sends for followers, saves for feed) and that YouTube's "70% of watch time" is a 2018 figure. Only PLAT_METRIC was corrected; the exported carousel slide and the archived Study-the-greats report still carry the old sentence
Hallalu CRM.fix: Open: move every platform-signal sentence to one claims table with a verified-on date, reference it from PLAT_METRIC, the carousel and the report, and re-verify on a schedule

Hallalu CRM.title: --ink-3 metadata text was 2.54:1 on white (fails WCAG AA) and --ink-2 was well below the premium band
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Hints, timestamps and metadata used --ink-3 (#9aa3b5) at 2.54:1; --ink-2 (#525d6f) measured 6.66:1. Dark-mode --ink-3 sits at 4.12:1.
Hallalu CRM.fix: --ink-2 #3d4757 (9.39:1) and --ink-3 #6b7688 (4.59:1), verified live by computing luminance in the browser. Dark-mode tertiary left slightly under 4.5:1.

Hallalu CRM.title: 39 icon-only buttons rely on the title attribute alone for a name (flagged, not fixed)
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The scan found 39 icon buttons with no aria-label, so screen readers announce nothing useful.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Add aria-label to every icon-only control and keep title as the tooltip.

Hallalu CRM.title: About 100 source files and zero automated tests (flagged, not fixed)
Hallalu CRM.symptom: The scan counted 94 to 101 source files with no test files; regressions rely on manual browser checks.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Add a core-loop smoke test (create lead, log call, send reminder) and run it before each deploy.

Hallalu CRM.title: Portal reports said 'verified' for paths that were never exercised
Hallalu CRM.symptom: Reported verified but not run: the quiet-week tone (the test lead had other activity so it read on-track; 'logic is sound'); the stable ?p=<pid> publish-to-view round trip (publish only fires for signed-in non-demo accounts, so no D1 row was ever created); the print layout (window.print was stubbed and .no-print elements counted); the accent-colour override ('trivially correct'); 3 of 6 first-gallery themes never viewed; the Storefront portal type (only Delivery was rendered); the 'light + dark pass across all 10 templates' (the script measured one scheme, light, and the assistant had noted non-default themes do not respond to prefers-color-scheme:dark); the owner Mark-done flip and the inbox route handlers (only SQL and a mocked fetch).
Hallalu CRM.fix: Not fixed: add an isolated empty-lead fixture, a signed-in test account for publish, print-media emulation, and a dark-scheme run.

Hallalu CRM.title: Two user-reported portal bugs (Preview not working, Edit not visible) were closed with asserted, undiagnosed causes
Hallalu CRM.symptom: For 'preview button not working' the report states as fact that it 'used a pop-up that browsers block'; the assistant never reproduced it and skipped the send-sheet Preview re-test. The old handler used leadOf(window.__portalLead), which is only set by the modal openers, so an unset or stale global would also make Preview silently do nothing. For 'im not seeing edit button', its own DOM probe had listed Edit among the toolbar buttons; it wrote 'I need to fix the real cause, not guess', then 'rather than fully diagnosing it I'll just make it more prominent', and the report states the cause as fact.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Edit made prominent and re-checked with getBoundingClientRect at 375px; Preview replaced by the full-page live preview and an Open anchor. Root causes remain unconfirmed.

Hallalu CRM.title: Verification traps in the Hallalu SPA made working code look broken and broken code look fine
Hallalu CRM.symptom: (a) Replacing window.S with buildSeedState() broke the defineProperty getters for leads and todos, so calEvents threw on forEach of undefined; (b) a forced save() left onboarded:false so the next load landed on onboarding and 'the Meetings section is missing'; (c) changing only the #hash of portal.html does not re-run decode(), so the old card stayed on screen; (d) the static python preview has no worker routing so /app 404s; (e) fetching the new ?v= asset URL before the deploy finished left a stale copy in the cache so the resizer and frame X looked absent until ?v= was bumped again.
Hallalu CRM.fix: Mutate S in place or run localStorage.clear() then load /app?demo=1&fresh=<timestamp>; use a full reload for hash changes; use wrangler dev or the live URL (not the static server) for worker routes; never fetch a versioned asset URL before the deploy completes and bump ?v= again if you did.

Hallalu CRM.title: npx wrangler deploy fails with ETARGET on an unresolvable miniflare alpha dependency (unpinned and @4 both break)

cross-cutting.title: Agent cat'ed a secrets config (~/.abba.json) while locating a repo, putting the app's non-rotatable pepper into the session transcript
cross-cutting.symptom: A Bash call `cat ~/.abba.json` printed the pepper in clear text into the stored conversation transcript.
cross-cutting.fix: Probe with test -f or print only key names (node -e Object.keys); never cat files named .*.json under the home directory that hold peppers, tokens or keys; treat any transcript that contains one as sensitive.

cross-cutting.title: AI-hallucinated dependency (slopsquatting) pulled into the build
cross-cutting.symptom: An install/import references a package that sounds right but isn't the real project; it either 404s the build or, worse, resolves to a squatter's malicious package.
cross-cutting.fix: Verify every AI-suggested dependency exists as the genuine project (publisher, repo, download history) before install; pin exact versions and commit a lockfile; review install scripts. Prefer platform-native bindings over adding packages at all.

cross-cutting.title: Broken authorization / business-logic is the dominant CRITICAL class in AI-built apps — verify flows, not just presence of auth
cross-cutting.symptom: Auth exists but multi-step authorization and ownership checks are wrong (e.g. object belongs to another user, capability not re-checked server-side).
cross-cutting.fix: Per-route ownership assertions server-side; test the negative case (user A cannot read/write user B's row); don't trust capability tokens without re-validation.

cross-cutting.title: Excessive agency for AI features
cross-cutting.symptom: An AI agent is given more tools, permissions or autonomy than its task needs, and can act without approval.
cross-cutting.fix: Least-privilege tools, scoped permissions, and human approval before irreversible or outward actions.

cross-cutting.title: Improper LLM output handling
cross-cutting.symptom: Model output rendered or executed without validation, enabling XSS, SSRF, path traversal or code execution downstream.
cross-cutting.fix: Validate/sanitize model output before rendering, running, or passing it to another system; treat it as untrusted.

cross-cutting.title: Insecure or deprecated cryptography
cross-cutting.symptom: Weak algorithms (MD5/SHA1 for passwords, ECB mode, hard-coded IV/salt, low KDF iterations).
cross-cutting.fix: Use a vetted KDF (bcrypt/scrypt/argon2 or PBKDF2 >=600k), random per-record salt/IV, AEAD ciphers.

cross-cutting.title: LLM endpoints need Unbounded-Consumption / billable-DoS guards (OWASP LLM 2025 LLM10)
cross-cutting.symptom: A public AI endpoint on a metered platform (Workers AI) can be hammered to run up cost or exhaust quota.
cross-cutting.fix: Rate-limit and cap tokens/length on every public LLM route; prefer FAQ/static fallback; alert on spend.

cross-cutting.title: LLM features: constrain Improper Output Handling + Excessive Agency (OWASP LLM 2025 LLM05/LLM06)
cross-cutting.symptom: Grounded/AI features (Workers AI chat, call-recap, FAQ bots) can emit attacker-influenced output that is rendered as HTML or used to trigger actions, and can be given more agency than the task needs.
cross-cutting.fix: Treat LLM output as untrusted: escape before render, never innerHTML it; scope tool/agent permissions to the minimum; keep a human-in-loop for side-effectful actions (matches the draft-and-send house style).

cross-cutting.title: Log injection / unsanitized logging
cross-cutting.symptom: User input written to logs unescaped (CWE-117), enabling forged log entries or downstream injection.
cross-cutting.fix: Sanitize/encode values before logging; never log secrets.

cross-cutting.title: Missing authorization / IDOR (object-level access)
cross-cutting.symptom: Endpoints check authentication but not that the caller owns the specific record (broken object-level authorization).
cross-cutting.fix: Enforce per-object ownership on every read/write; never trust an id from the client as proof of access.

cross-cutting.title: Missing input sanitization / validation
cross-cutting.symptom: The single most common flaw in AI-generated code — inputs used unsanitized in queries, HTML, filesystem or commands.
cross-cutting.fix: Validate + sanitize every external input at the boundary; allow-list, not deny-list.

cross-cutting.title: Native/mobile AI apps ship data-exposing misconfigs ~99% of the time — audit secrets/ATS/storage before ship
cross-cutting.symptom: Shipped native builds embed keys, allow cleartext traffic, or leave world-readable storage.
cross-cutting.fix: Before shipping a native build (Abba/Stitchhooky/Finished): no embedded secrets, ATS on, scoped storage, no debug logging of PII.

cross-cutting.title: No rate limiting on expensive / AI endpoints
cross-cutting.symptom: Unauthenticated or unthrottled endpoints that call paid AI / browser-rendering / email can be run up into a billing DoS.
cross-cutting.fix: Per-IP/user rate limits + auth/turnstile on any endpoint that costs money or compute.

cross-cutting.title: Portfolio scan 2026-10-04: XSS-INNERHTML fires HIGH on 18 of 23 apps
cross-cutting.symptom: innerHTML / insertAdjacentHTML sinks with interpolated data are the single most widespread high-severity issue across the portfolio (18/23 scanned apps).
cross-cutting.fix: Sweep every app for innerHTML sinks; prefer textContent/DOM APIs or an escaping helper that also escapes quotes; make XSS-INNERHTML a release gate.

cross-cutting.title: Pre-approved wildcard Bash rules plus an instruction to re-download the CLI on every run give code execution to whoever controls that Worker
cross-cutting.symptom: Global instructions tell every agent to re-fetch apz.mjs, and the same pattern exists for the Pixelbake and Breadcrumb CLIs, from a coconvo.workers.dev URL before each run, and settings.local.json pre-approves node ~/.aprizely/apz.mjs with a wildcard so it runs without a prompt. A compromised Worker deploy, DNS or account takeover could ship code that runs unattended with the user's tokens and file access on the next agent run.
cross-cutting.fix: Pin each CLI by SHA-256 (keep the expected hash locally, verify after the download and refuse to run on a mismatch) or serve a signed manifest; write the download to a temp file and swap it in only after verification; narrow the allow rules to exact subcommands.

cross-cutting.title: Prompt injection (direct and indirect)
cross-cutting.symptom: Untrusted input (user text or content fetched from a page/doc/email) overrides the model's instructions or drives actions.
cross-cutting.fix: Treat all tool/observed content as untrusted; separate instructions from data; confirm side-effectful actions; don't act on instructions found in content.

cross-cutting.title: Raw Cloudflare API calls were made with the wrangler OAuth token regex-extracted from default.toml, while the same kind of action was blocked as credential hunting in another session
cross-cutting.symptom: To list zones, enable Email Routing and attempt a DNS record the session read oauth_token out of ~/.wrangler/config/default.toml and called api.cloudflare.com directly; the DNS write failed for scope, the routing enable succeeded; in session 0436b9e8 an env/token inspection command was denied by the classifier
cross-cutting.fix: Open: prefer wrangler subcommands or a scoped API token created for the task, never regex a token out of the config, and treat extraction of any token file as needing explicit approval

cross-cutting.title: Request state stored in Worker module globals leaks across users
cross-cutting.symptom: Under load, one user intermittently sees another user's data (auth context, cart, tenant id), or the Worker throws 'Cannot perform I/O on behalf of a different request'.
cross-cutting.fix: Keep zero mutable request state at module scope. Create per-request objects inside fetch() and thread them through function arguments; put shared handles on env bindings. Treat module globals as read-only constants only.

cross-cutting.title: Secrets committed / exposed to the client
cross-cutting.symptom: API keys, tokens or private keys in source, client bundles or the repo (400+ found across vibe-coded apps).
cross-cutting.fix: Keep secrets server-side in env bindings; never ship them to the browser; scan the tree + git history.

cross-cutting.title: sed-based secret masking silently failed on pretty-printed JSON, printing the Bug Ledger token into the transcript
cross-cutting.symptom: A command meant to show ~/.bugledger.json with the token masked printed the full token in the tool output, so it sits in the session transcript.
cross-cutting.fix: Never cat credential files. Read them with node and print only the length or a prefix, or mask via a JSON parser rather than a regex. Rotate any token that was printed.

cross-cutting.title: SQL / NoSQL injection from string-built queries
cross-cutting.symptom: Queries assembled by concatenating user input instead of parameterized.
cross-cutting.fix: Always use parameterized queries / prepared statements; never string-concatenate user input into a query.

cross-cutting.title: SSRF: allowlist outbound fetch targets (CWE-918, #1 AI-code flaw)
cross-cutting.symptom: A server-side fetch/proxy can be pointed at internal metadata endpoints or arbitrary hosts.
cross-cutting.fix: Allowlist schemes+hosts, resolve and block private/link-local IP ranges, disable redirects to new hosts, and never echo raw upstream errors.

cross-cutting.title: System prompt leakage (OWASP LLM07:2025)
cross-cutting.symptom: Internal system-prompt rules, filters, permissions or hidden logic can be extracted by users and used to bypass controls.
cross-cutting.fix: Never put secrets/keys or the only copy of an access rule in the prompt; enforce authorization server-side; treat any prompt content as potentially public.

cross-cutting.title: System-prompt / context leakage when page context is stuffed into an LLM prompt (OWASP LLM 2025 LLM07/LLM02)
cross-cutting.symptom: Grounded features that inject page or FAQ context into the prompt can leak the system prompt or sensitive context back to the user.
cross-cutting.fix: Keep secrets out of prompts; segregate instructions from retrieved context; assume the system prompt can be extracted.

cross-cutting.title: Vector & embedding weaknesses in RAG (OWASP LLM08:2025)
cross-cutting.symptom: Retrieved documents poison answers, or one tenant's embeddings leak into another's results.
cross-cutting.fix: Scope/partition the vector store per tenant, sanitize and provenance-tag ingested docs, and treat retrieved text as untrusted input to the model.

cross-cutting.title: XSS from unescaped output rendered to HTML
cross-cutting.symptom: User/model data written into the DOM without encoding — ~86% of AI-generated samples fail XSS defence.
cross-cutting.fix: Escape on output (incl. quotes) or use textContent; add a Content-Security-Policy as defence-in-depth.

cross-cutting.title: XSS is the #1 failure mode of AI-generated code (86% fail rate) — audit every innerHTML/template sink
cross-cutting.symptom: AI-written UI code repeatedly builds DOM via innerHTML/template strings with uninterpolated user data.
cross-cutting.fix: Grep for innerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML/`${}` into DOM; use textContent or escape; the ledger's XSS-INNERHTML detector should run on every build.
