Abba.symptom: The native notifications sheet showed '56 yrs' ago and mis-sorted signals and fills.
Abba.fix: Added an explicit UTC parser for the space-separated format; signals and fills now sort correctly and show '3 days, 20 hr'.

Abba.title: Swift URL.appendingPathComponent percent-encoded '?', so native candle requests failed and the backtest silently did nothing
Abba.symptom: On iPhone/Mac, Backtest returned to the same screen with no result and no error.
Abba.fix: Build the URL from a string/URLComponents so the query survives; backtest then ran on real Kraken candles (commit b026e6a).

Abba.title: Vision watchlist hallucinated tickers: model-extracted symbols were added without validation
Abba.symptom: Uploading a chart/screenshot to build a watchlist added symbols that were never in the image (and some that do not exist).
Abba.fix: Validate every extracted symbol against the real price feed (candle/quote lookup) before it is offered, and make the watchlist add confirm-first (user ticks the symbols to keep). Treat model-extracted identifiers as untrusted until resolved against a source of truth.

Abba.title: Worker router skipped JSON body parsing for /api/media/*, so new JSON multipart-upload routes received an empty body
Abba.symptom: The new create/part/complete multipart endpoints returned errors because body was empty even though the client sent JSON.
Abba.fix: Parse the JSON body inside those three handlers; proven with served multipart test calls and then the Claude Fathom pipeline on the uploaded memo.

Abba.title: '24/7 bots' claim was false: bots only ran while the browser tab was open
Abba.symptom: UI and copy promised bots that trade around the clock, but strategy evaluation lived entirely in the client; closing the tab stopped them.
Abba.fix: Add a Cloudflare cron trigger that evaluates enabled bots server-side against the same candle feed and records signals; until it exists, copy must say 'runs while Abba is open'. Do not ship an availability claim the architecture cannot meet.

Abba.title: Trader-journal name 'Abba' collides with Polar Music's ABBA registered marks
Abba.symptom: The 'Abba' name overlaps the band's registered marks: UK IR UK00801494598 (classes 9/35/38/42 and more, to 2029), EUTM 000620732 (classes 9/41), US class 9 filings, and a s.10(3) reputation claim.
Abba.fix: Open: rename, or re-brand under a house mark with a distinctive composite, before marketing spend.

Abba.title: pkill -x Abba also kills the iOS Simulator's Abba process (same executable name), which looked exactly like a Save crash
Abba.symptom: After relaunching the Mac build the iPhone simulator app dropped to the home screen right after Save; crash reports and log show found nothing, and the identical Save path then worked three times with a log stream attached.
Abba.fix: Terminate with xcrun simctl terminate <udid> <bundle-id> for the simulator and pkill -f '<build path>/Abba.app/Contents/MacOS/Abba' for the Mac binary; before chasing a 'crash' with no crash report, check whether your own cleanup command killed the app.

Abba.title: Ask Ava chat history was lost on every re-render
Abba.symptom: Opening another tab/theme change or any re-render cleared the Ask Ava conversation.
Abba.fix: Hold messages in the app store (and persist to the docs/sync layer) and rebuild the DOM from it on each render.

Abba.title: Fixed top-right heart/notification button covered page titles and header content
Abba.symptom: The owner reported the heart overlapping the information on pages; it sat over title rows and the first row of content on desktop and mobile.
Abba.fix: Anchored the heart in the page header flow top-right (the Finished pattern) and made every title row reserve a gutter for it; an overlap sweep on dashboard and badges found zero elements under it on desktop and mobile.

Abba.title: Mobile bottom bar stays dark on light themes (open)
Abba.symptom: On light-background themes the mobile bottom navigation remains a dark bar instead of following the theme.
Abba.fix: Not fixed - route the bar background and icon colours through the theme tokens like the sidebar.

Abba.title: Mobile bottom-nav 'More' tab rendered with an empty icon slot so it did not align with its siblings
Abba.symptom: On phones the More tab showed a blank space where every other tab had an icon.
Abba.fix: Added a rounded 3x3 app-grid icon in the same 1.8px stroke set and bumped icons.js to ?v=4.

Abba.title: Muted/faint text was nearly invisible on light-tinted themes such as babypink
Abba.symptom: On pastel themes the secondary grey text and placeholders washed out against the tinted background; the user asked for the grey to follow each theme's colour and stay readable.
Abba.fix: Per-theme muted/dim tokens (e.g. mauve on babypink) and theme-tinted inputs with readable placeholders; verified on the babypink theme.

Abba.title: Native BotView.whenText printed the literal source (Int(r.stopPct)) instead of the number
Abba.symptom: The iPhone and Mac strategy-bot rule text showed raw interpolation code in place of the stop percentage.
Abba.fix: Added the missing backslash; the native build is green; found while porting the plain-English explainer to native.

Abba.title: Native dark/glass pass: large currency number wrapped ('$20146 8'), pushed views lost the theme background and white tiles glared
Abba.symptom: On iPhone the big account-size figure wrapped mid-number, pushed screens showed black behind light-theme tiles, tiles were blinding white in dark mode and pager dots overlapped card content.
Abba.fix: Single-line scaled numbers, theme background on pushed views, a glass CardStyle for dark mode and dot spacing; verified in light and dark on the exact screen from the user's screenshot.

Abba.title: Saved themes and sidebar colour sets could not be renamed after saving
Abba.symptom: The owner said they were not letting her edit the name of a theme after saving it; the name was fixed at save time.
Abba.fix: Moved themes into Settings as 'Themes & appearance' with a pencil rename on every saved theme and saved sidebar colour; theme names persisted in the settings key the Worker accepts.

Abba.title: 1,433 Xcode build products under native/build were committed to git
Abba.symptom: git status listed 1,433 tracked deletions under native/build after a clean build directory.
Abba.fix: Removed the files from the index and added native/build/ to .gitignore (history still holds the blobs; the repo is local only).

Abba.title: App's own TimelineView type shadows SwiftUI.TimelineView, giving opaque compile errors ('extra trailing closure', 'no member periodic')
Abba.symptom: TradesView.swift:20 failed with 'extra trailing closure passed in call', 'type EnvironmentObject<Store> has no member periodic' and 'cannot infer contextual base .now' for a plain TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 1)).
Abba.fix: Qualify as SwiftUI.TimelineView(.periodic(from: .now, by: 1)). Avoid naming app views after SwiftUI types (TimelineView, Section, Label, List).

Abba.title: iPhone target failed to build on .onChange(of:){ _, v in } (iOS 17-only) while the Mac target compiled, after a commit had already claimed both builds green
Abba.symptom: xcodebuild -sdk iphonesimulator: 'onChange(of:initial:_:) is only available in iOS 17.0 or newer' at LessonsView.swift:118 and :148 (and StrategiesView); the macOS build of the same code succeeded, so the earlier commit message 'both targets build' was wrong.
Abba.fix: Switched to the single-parameter .onChange(of:) { v in } form; rebuilt BOTH targets (iphonesimulator and macosx) and corrected the claim in a follow-up commit. Build every target before saying 'builds green'.

Abba.title: Native app targeted iOS 17.0 so it could not install on the owner's iOS 16.7.16 iPhone
Abba.symptom: The iPhone build would have been refused on the owner's phone even after Developer Mode was enabled.
Abba.fix: Lowered the deployment target to iOS 16.0, rebuilt with zero availability warnings and re-ran the app on the simulator.

Abba.title: Repo history carried 388 MB of native build artifacts (20 MB binaries) despite native/build/ being gitignored, discovered only at the first GitHub push
Abba.symptom: Creating the private remote and pushing was very slow; git count-objects showed size-pack 388 MiB and the five largest blobs were Abba.app executables under native/build/.
Abba.fix: Push still worked (no file near 100 MB) and the history rewrite was left as the owner's call; recommended git-filter-repo --path native/build --invert-paths. Before a first push run: git rev-list --objects --all | git cat-file --batch-check | sort by size.

Abba.title: Swift 'unable to type-check this expression in reasonable time' from a long string concatenation inside Text(...)
Abba.symptom: StrategiesView.swift:292 failed the Mac build with 'the compiler is unable to type-check this expression in reasonable time' on a Text() built from optional map + string concatenations + String(format:).
Abba.fix: Extracted the pieces into a small helper statsLine(...) that builds the string step by step and passed the result to Text; build succeeded.

Pixelbake.title: Admin status is granted to anyone who signs up with an unclaimed handle in ADMIN_HANDLES (rhema and rhemajoy are free on the live app)
Pixelbake.symptom: isAdmin() is true for any user whose handle string is in the ADMIN_HANDLES var (seven,rhema,rhemajoy,rhe). Signup is open and only checks that a handle is free and not in the small RESERVED set; a live POST /api/auth/check returned status free for 'rhema' and 'rhemajoy' (taken for 'rhe' and 'seven'). Whoever registers an unclaimed admin handle gets /api/admin/grant (up to 1,000,000 credits and any plan to any handle), showcase curation and every admin credit exemption.
Pixelbake.fix: Open - remove unclaimed handles from ADMIN_HANDLES (or add them to RESERVED and pre-create them), key admin on user ids set by migration, and require a second factor or the owner's agent token for /api/admin/grant.

Pixelbake.title: pxb login writes the API token file ~/.pixelbake.json with default 0644 permissions (world-readable)
Pixelbake.symptom: ls -la showed ~/.pixelbake.json as -rw-r--r-- while the copied ~/.pixelbake-rhe.json was -rw-------; any local user or process could read the bearer token that files and bills images.
Pixelbake.fix: Write with {mode:0o600} and chmod existing files on login; audit the other CLIs that save tokens (apz.mjs, worklog.mjs, bugledger) for the same default.

Pixelbake.title: Sign-in has no brute-force lockout on 4-8 digit PINs and reveals which handles exist
Pixelbake.symptom: POST /api/auth/signin checks the PIN with no attempt counter, delay or lockout, PINs may be as short as 4 digits, and the failure message is 'No account with that handle.' for an unknown handle versus 'Wrong PIN.' for a known one, so handles can be enumerated and any account (including the admin and credit-holding ones) can be guessed online.
Pixelbake.fix: Open - add a per-handle and per-IP failed-attempt counter in D1 with a lockout window, a single generic 'Wrong handle or PIN' error, constant-time hash comparison, and a minimum PIN length of 6.

Pixelbake.title: Copying images between accounts via upload flattens generated records to kind:upload; model, seed, prompt and cost survive only as notes text
Pixelbake.symptom: After migrating 173 images from @seven to @rhe the library showed 'Uploads 232' and 0 credits for them; model/seed/prompt are no longer queryable fields.
Pixelbake.fix: Add an owner-authorised import (or account merge) that copies kind/model/seed/prompt/neurons/parent ids and raises the cap for lossless masters; until then write provenance into notes and keep the master in the source account.

Pixelbake.title: A solid-black failed generation was filed in the library like a normal image
Pixelbake.symptom: Library item 'Amara hyperreal test' (dreamshaper-8-lcm, 768x768) was a 1.8 KB all-black PNG. It showed as a successful bake and was enlarged by the upscaler.
Pixelbake.fix: Open. Detect near-uniform output by byte-size or histogram check, then fail the bake and refund credits, or auto-retry.

Pixelbake.title: Brand brief drafted from a JS-rendered site saw only the empty HTML shell and invented a grey, corporate brand
Pixelbake.symptom: Marketing-from-URL for a client-rendered site drafted a brief with guessed grey palette, corporate audience and generic style instead of the real brand.
Pixelbake.fix: Corrected palette, audience, style and the six concepts through the briefs API (PATCH /api/briefs) before spending any credits. Recommended: detect a near-empty page, render it with a browser fetch, or warn 'I only saw N characters, check the brief' before the first bake.

Pixelbake.title: Character auto-describe silently saved an empty identity brief
Pixelbake.symptom: Creating a character from a photo succeeded but the brief and traits were empty (refs:1, traits keys: none), so no identity anchor reached later bakes.
Pixelbake.fix: Two-step pipeline, vision to prose then a text model to structured JSON, as the existing describe endpoint does. The resulting brief is now enumerated (eyes, nose, jaw, hair, skin, distinctive marks).

Pixelbake.title: Free model dreamshaper-8-lcm returned an all-black PNG, reported success and charged a credit
Pixelbake.symptom: pxb gen --model dreamshaper-8-lcm printed a success line (0 Neurons, 1 credit) and wrote a 768x768 file that was a black frame.
Pixelbake.fix: Worked around by using flux-2-dev once credits allowed. Recommended: reject near-uniform output server-side (mean luminance and variance), refund the credit and return an error.

Pixelbake.title: GET /api/images and pxb list silently cap limit at 200, so 'list everything' reconciliations undercount a 372-image library
Pixelbake.symptom: `pxb list --limit 1000` and /api/images?limit=1000 both returned exactly 200 records; the library looked like 200 while per-project queries summed to 372.
Pixelbake.fix: Return total plus a next cursor (or honour larger limits) and have pxb list warn when count equals the cap.

Pixelbake.title: Prompt improver returned 502 when the LLM wrapped its answer in prose instead of clean JSON
Pixelbake.symptom: POST /api/improve returned 'Could not improve that one' 502 on a short idea although the model had produced a good prompt; CLI printed pixelbake: /api/improve -> 502.
Pixelbake.fix: If JSON parsing yields no prompt but the raw text is >80 chars, regex-extract the 'prompt' field and strip the trailing negative key as a fallback before returning 502.

Pixelbake.title: Your-days per-day route read the wrong path segment (404) and the headline printed raw DB kind words
Pixelbake.symptom: The new per-day summary page 404'd for valid dates and its headline said things like 'generated, upload, fix' straight from the DB enum instead of readable kind names.
Pixelbake.fix: Read the final path segment as the date and map kinds to human labels before composing the headline; verified on all four surfaces (web, CLI, MCP, share).

Pixelbake.title: Hero headline uses the Claude Code name and the run recommended clearing it before paid use
Pixelbake.symptom: The website hero and the developer hooks say the studio is for Claude Code; the run flagged that this is another company's product name inside an advertisement and left it unresolved
Pixelbake.fix: Open: check the vendor's brand rules, prefer a descriptive phrase (for coding agents) in paid placements, and keep the product name only as plain factual compatibility text

Pixelbake.title: Pain ad headline in quotation marks reads as a customer review but is a composed line
Pixelbake.symptom: The lead static and carousel slide 1 print 'It failed. It still took my credits.' in quotes as the customer's own words; the complaint exists in 2026 Trustpilot reviews of two rivals but the sentence is invented and was read through a summarising tool
Pixelbake.fix: Open: either quote a real review verbatim with its source and date, or remove the quotation marks and label the line as a paraphrase; keep a quote-provenance field in the creative spec

Pixelbake.title: Product name identical to an existing UK registered word mark in class 42
Pixelbake.symptom: A live paid product (Stripe plans $9/$29/$99) trades as 'Pixelbake', identical to UK word mark UK00003894245 (class 42 SaaS/graphic-design platforms, Pxlbake Ltd, registered 23/06/2023, plus PXLBAKE UK00003888678).
Pixelbake.fix: Open: rename before any paid marketing. Registration is not required to launch, but launching under a registered name is infringement from day one.

Pixelbake.title: Site and pitch deck quote FLUX.2 dev at 42, 51 and 40 credits in three places while billing charged 42 and 63
Pixelbake.symptom: The marketing run read the live site and the pitch and found three different credit figures for the same model, none matching the 42 (square) and 63 (portrait) actually debited
Pixelbake.fix: Open: render every credit figure from the same cost function (or a generated table) and add a check that greps the site and deck for the model's credit numbers

Pixelbake.title: Credit balance fell two to four times more than the listed cost of the bakes with no record of the difference
Pixelbake.symptom: Two sessions saw 1,029 credits leave against 483 listed (v1) and 1,728 against about 441 (v2); the rest could not be attributed.
Pixelbake.fix: Record every credit movement (bake, upload, refund) as a transaction with a reason and surface the running total in the CLI.

Pixelbake.title: Finished bakes silently swap the placeholder for the image, so users cannot tell when a long job is done
Pixelbake.symptom: User feedback: 'I don't know when it finishes'. A studio bake replaced the loading tile with the image with no signal, and modal results (upscale, fix, paint) just opened the lightbox.
Pixelbake.fix: markFresh() pop-in with a fading 'Just baked' flag and scroll-into-view. openLightbox(id, fresh) shows a labelled success ribbon such as 'Upscaled 2x - Clear'.

Pixelbake.title: Mobile horizontal overflow on Bulk grid (108px), Connect (532px) and pitch deck (102px) at 390px
Pixelbake.symptom: The 390px QA pass reported pageX overflow on the Bulk contenteditable grid, the Connect page (code/CLI tables) and the pitch deck while every other view was 0.
Pixelbake.fix: Added a max-width:900px safety block: .main{overflow-x:hidden}, .card/.table-wrap/.chips/.estimate max-width:100%, narrower .grid-edit .cell; re-measured overflowPx 0 on every view.

Pixelbake.title: Mobile nav drawer stayed open after hash navigation and covered the page content
Pixelbake.symptom: At 390px, tapping a sidebar link changed the hash route but the drawer stayed open over the tiles; a Playwright click on .tile timed out because the sidebar intercepted pointer events.
Pixelbake.fix: hashchange listener now does #side.classList.remove('open') before route(); mobile pass re-run with menuClosedAfterNav true.

Pixelbake.title: Open modal survives a hash-route change
Pixelbake.symptom: Navigating to #library while the Upscale/lightbox modal was open left the modal on screen until a hard reload.
Pixelbake.fix: Open. Close open modals in route() or on hashchange.

Pixelbake.title: 402 'Top up in Settings' names no account, so a CLI on the @seven test account looked like the topped-up @rhe account was empty
Pixelbake.symptom: Three parallel flux-2-dev bakes failed 'You need 42 credits for this bake and have 4' right after the user said they had topped up; project images were baked and filed on @seven; pxb balance is an unknown command.
Pixelbake.fix: Found the mismatch with whoami and stats (@seven, 4 credits) and told the user which account held the credit. Recommended: 402 body and CLI error include {handle, balance, needed}, a pxb balance alias, and a whoami-must-be-@rhe check at the start of any task that makes images.

Pixelbake.title: Llama 3.2 vision describe fails with error 5016 until the model licence is accepted once per account
Pixelbake.symptom: First POST /api/images/:id/describe returned 'Thank you for agreeing to this...' (5016) instead of a description; the Re-engineer, Prompt lab and brand-from-URL describe paths all failed on a fresh account.
Pixelbake.fix: Catch /agree|licen|terms/ errors, call env.AI.run(VISION_MODEL,{prompt:'agree'}) once (swallow its own error), retry the describe, and only then surface a friendly error.

Pixelbake.title: Premium third-party Workers AI model (Pruna p-image-upscale) shipped as an engine but fails with 'Insufficient AI Gateway credits'
Pixelbake.symptom: The Max-detail upscale engine returned '2021: Insufficient AI Gateway credits' on the first live call, so the advertised best-in-class engine could not run.
Pixelbake.fix: Failure maps to a friendly 'needs AI Gateway billing - nothing charged' error. Default engine switched to the first-party Images-binding 'Clear' path. Max-detail stays gated and the pitch deck labels it 'ready, needs AI Gateway'.

Pixelbake.title: pxb gen --ref with a reference id owned by another account returns a bare 404 'Reference image not found in your library'
Pixelbake.symptom: Six FLUX.2 dev re-bakes failed with '/api/generate -> 404 Reference image not found in your library' even though the reference existed.
Pixelbake.fix: Re-ran with the token that owns the reference (PIXELBAKE_TOKEN per call) and uploaded the ref to the second account for later runs; the CLI should name the account mismatch in the 404 message.

Pixelbake.title: Upscale via the Images binding is filed as 0 Neurons / $0.00000 although Cloudflare bills per unique transformation
Pixelbake.symptom: Clear upscale results show '0 Neurons - $0.00000 - 2 cr' in the library, which contradicts the studio's 'true cost per image' promise.
Pixelbake.fix: Open. Record an estimated per-transformation USD cost for the Images binding, and a measured or flat figure for the Pruna engine, so the cost ledger and margins stay honest.

Breadcrumb.title: +feature truncation swallows text and skips redaction
Breadcrumb.symptom: The `+feature` command read a fixed 60 characters, swallowing the rest of the sentence, and the swallowed text bypassed redaction (secret-leak risk).
Breadcrumb.fix: Read the full text and route it through redaction, using exact-match so tokens like `#bug` can't be swallowed.

Breadcrumb.title: Device-connect reopen link was a dead end: approve code lost when the app was already signed in elsewhere
Breadcrumb.symptom: Opening the device-connect link on a second device led to a page with no way to complete approval.
Breadcrumb.fix: Support /?approve=<code> auto-approve after sign-in and a Settings 'paste code' fallback; keep the code in sessionStorage across the auth step.

Breadcrumb.title: No brute-force lockout on 5-digit passcode sign-in/recovery
Breadcrumb.symptom: A 5-digit passcode could be guessed with unlimited attempts on sign-in and forgot-passcode
Breadcrumb.fix: Added an attempts table with gateCheck/gateFail/gateClear keyed separately by email and device IP, wired into sign-in and recovery; escalating lockouts 5->5min, 8->30min, 12->6h; cleared on success. Verified live: 6th miss returns HTTP 429

Breadcrumb.title: Upsert ON CONFLICT omitted meta, dropping an edited prompt's asks ledger on sync
Breadcrumb.symptom: Editing a prompt lost its asks/convo/estimated data after cloud sync
Breadcrumb.fix: Add meta to the ON CONFLICT update set (and fix the size cap) so edited prompt metadata round-trips

Breadcrumb.title: Recovery codes hashed inconsistently
Breadcrumb.symptom: Valid recovery codes could fail because hashing was inconsistent.
Breadcrumb.fix: Hash recovery codes consistently.

Breadcrumb.title: Docs not synced
Breadcrumb.symptom: Docs weren't reliably persisted/synced.
Breadcrumb.fix: Added a proper synced `docs` table and fixed the size cap.

Breadcrumb.title: Landing-demo 'Sam' data bled into newly created accounts
Breadcrumb.symptom: Exploring the landing-page demo, then signing up, produced an account pre-filled with demo projects/prompts and greeted the user as 'Sam'
Breadcrumb.fix: Reset state to blank on signup before adopting the account; added a cloudPull auto-heal that resets accounts matching the demo fingerprint

Breadcrumb.title: Sync blob over 2 MB silently 413'd: large journals stopped backing up without notice
Breadcrumb.symptom: Cloud backup silently stopped for heavy users; local data diverged from the server.
Breadcrumb.fix: Move large content to the generic docs table (per-document rows, size cap per doc) and surface sync failures in the UI with retry.

Breadcrumb.title: `>cursor` builder-switch token silently discarded
Breadcrumb.symptom: A `>cursor` builder switch inside a captured prompt was silently dropped.
Breadcrumb.fix: Fixed the parsing so the builder-switch token is preserved.

Breadcrumb.title: Capture-bar quick chips don't update the prompt placeholder

Breadcrumb.title: NUL bytes in worker.js source make grep/file treat it as binary
Breadcrumb.symptom: A plain grep silently matched nothing in a 1568-line source file, so an agent wrongly concluded the /api/log, /api/worklog and /worklog.mjs endpoints didn't exist and was about to recreate the client; `file` reported the source as data, not text.

Breadcrumb.title: Worklog CLI prompt assumed ~/.breadcrumb/worklog.mjs was already installed

Bug Ledger.title: Harvester copied a live sign-in PIN verbatim into an append-only ledger row and filed it under the wrong app
Bug Ledger.symptom: A harvested row reads "Live: https://joy-day.coconvo.workers.dev · PIN <6 digits> (saved in /.joyday/config.json)" under Hallalu CRM. GET /api/activity and the other read routes need no key, so the PIN is publicly readable, and because the ledger is append-only it cannot be removed or edited afterwards
Bug Ledger.fix: Open: add a redaction pass to harvest.mjs (PIN or passcode followed by digits, key=, token-like strings, long hex or base64) that drops the row, and allow a tombstone or redact action for secrets only; rotate the exposed PIN

Bug Ledger.title: Editing the generated public/bugs.json lost eight appended entries when gen.mjs regenerated it
Bug Ledger.symptom: Entries added by hand to public/bugs.json vanished after the next gen.mjs run.
Bug Ledger.fix: Edit only the source file, mark the generated file read-only with a header comment, and have gen.mjs refuse to run when the output has unsaved differences.

Bug Ledger.title: Catalogue cache stored an empty result after one transient fetch miss, so coverage read 0/0 until the isolate recycled
Bug Ledger.symptom: After a deploy the full-catalogue scan reported 0/0 and /api/checks coverage was wrong; the next requests on the same isolate kept the empty value
Bug Ledger.fix: Cache only a successful, non-empty result and retry on the next request; the test is to fail the first fetch and expect the second request to recover

Bug Ledger.title: GET /api/bugs?limit=1000 is silently capped at 200 with no paging, so agents read a truncated ledger
Bug Ledger.symptom: A request for 1000 returned 200 rows and no next cursor, hiding older entries from dedupe and harvesting.
Bug Ledger.fix: Return total and next in the response and support before=<ts> paging; document the cap in AGENT.md.

Bug Ledger.title: Harvested layer is mostly clipped assistant sentences: 73% end in an ellipsis, none carries a file, and 52% are filed to one app
Bug Ledger.symptom: Of 399 harvested rows in the live ledger 291 have titles cut mid-sentence at about 80 characters, 28 begin with a bullet dash, about 89 begin with narration such as 'One caveat', 'Here' or 'Now', every one has file null, and 206 are attributed to Hallalu CRM; rows from a disk-cleanup session were filed under Hallalu CRM and Wedding Planner
Bug Ledger.fix: Open: require a bug-shaped record (symptom plus a file or command) before filing, store the full sentence in the note and a derived short title, resolve the app from the files touched, and count harvested rows separately from curated ones in the KPIs

Bug Ledger.title: Report page dies on a transient fetch failure ('Couldn't load — Failed to fetch')
Bug Ledger.symptom: Opening a sweep report during a network blip or mid-deploy showed 'Couldn't load — TypeError: Failed to fetch' and never recovered.
Bug Ledger.fix: Wrapped each fetch in a retrying getJSON() (2 retries + backoff) that returns a fallback instead of rejecting; on empty data show a friendly 'connection dropped' + a Retry link instead of a raw error.

Bug Ledger.title: Sweep report attributed ledger additions by a 30-minute time window instead of by session, so a concurrent session's entries appeared as this sweep's finds
Bug Ledger.symptom: The 'Added to the ledger from this sweep' card listed submissions made within about 30 minutes of the sweep timestamp (first filtered by app, then widened to all apps), with provenance only as a project label
Bug Ledger.fix: Open: stamp every /api/bugs submission with the active worklog session id (or require one) and have the report and timeline group additions by that id

Bug Ledger.title: Apps KPI counted non-app buckets such as cross-cutting and Unknown, showing 18 apps instead of 16
Bug Ledger.symptom: The headline said 18 apps while only 16 real apps existed, and AGENT.md, llms.txt and the checklist totals repeated a hardcoded 18.
Bug Ledger.fix: Compute realAppCount excluding cross-cutting and Unknown and generate every published count from it.

Bug Ledger.title: Marketing set shows AI-generated people disclosed on only 1 of 7 photo pieces, with a composite confession quote (flagged, not fixed)
Bug Ledger.symptom: A 2026 study found women rate an ad lower when the model is labelled AI-generated, yet only the Story carried a disclosure; the pain quote was modelled on a real complaint, not a testimonial.
Bug Ledger.fix: Decide one policy (disclose on every AI-person piece or commission real photography) and label composite quotes as illustrative.

Bug Ledger.title: An append-only trigger rejection reached the client as a raw HTTP 500 with the SQL error text
Bug Ledger.symptom: Re-opening a finished worklog session was correctly refused by the database trigger but the response was a 500 containing the raw error string, so agents could not tell tampering from an outage
Bug Ledger.fix: Map trigger aborts to a 403 with a clear message through one writeErr helper used by every write path, and keep the trigger as the authority

Bug Ledger.title: GET /api/bugs returns entries under 'submitted' capped at 100, so naive parsers read an empty ledger
Bug Ledger.symptom: Checking that a POST landed, a parser looking for bugs/items/data reported 'total in ledger: 0' although the entry was the newest of 100 returned.
Bug Ledger.fix: Document the shape and add ?id=/?limit=/?q= filters, or alias the key as 'items'. Agents should verify a write with the POST response id or a keyed lookup.

Bug Ledger.title: Worklog narration through a zsh variable with stderr sent to /dev/null failed silently for the whole session
Bug Ledger.symptom: Every narration call failed, the story page showed 6 findings still open, and the finished session (HTTP 409) could not be corrected afterwards.
Bug Ledger.fix: Call the CLI directly (node path/worklog.mjs ...), never hide stderr on state-changing calls, and check the first call's output.

Bug Ledger.title: Activity timeline re-renders every poll, replaying entrance animations (flicker)
Bug Ledger.symptom: The /timeline feed rebuilt its whole innerHTML on every 4s poll even when nothing changed, so every card replayed its 'rise' entrance animation and the page visibly flickered.
Bug Ledger.fix: Compute a content signature from stable fields (event ids/status/coverage/progress) and skip the re-render when it's unchanged; only rebuild when content actually changes.

Bug Ledger.title: Automated git commit used `git add -A`, sweeping a co-editing session's work
Bug Ledger.symptom: The hourly harvester's auto-commit ran mid-work and its `git add -A` staged an in-progress session's unrelated edits, committing them under the wrong message.
Bug Ledger.fix: Stage an explicit allow-list of the tool's own outputs (harvested.json / scan-findings.json + their gen artefacts), never `git add -A`. (This is the 'stage only files you touched' optimiser.)

Bug Ledger.title: Deepscan bug-phase total includes category:security titles, so a payload without them scored 298/337
Bug Ledger.symptom: The first coverage post returned 298/337 with 39 missed items, all security-category bugs.
Bug Ledger.fix: State in the skill that phase 1 must list every title (security included) in found or notFound, or exclude them from the bug total consistently.

Bug Ledger.title: Scanner INVIS-HIDDEN flags legitimate U+00A0 placeholders, a deliberate BOM stripper and thin-space number formatting as smuggled Unicode
Bug Ledger.symptom: finished-app produced INVIS-HIDDEN highs at Notes.tsx:135-140 (U+00A0 in JSX {p.content || ' '}), PinPad.tsx:50, calc.ts:226 (thin space) and kindle.ts:11 (intentional BOM strip); all were false positives after a codepoint-level read.
Bug Ledger.fix: Triaged as false positives with the exact codepoints; detector should flag only U+200B-200F, U+202A-202E, U+2060-2064 and a mid-file U+FEFF, and allow U+00A0/U+202F/U+2009 inside JSX text and string literals.

Bug Ledger.title: Sweep commands and reports did not say whether they checked one project or the whole catalogue, so "full" was ambiguous
Bug Ledger.symptom: After a deep security scan the owner asked whether it covered only the security items for the project in hand or every project; the prompts, task labels and final report gave no scope line
Bug Ledger.fix: Added a scope note to /securitysweep, /fullscan and /deepscan, task labels that name the scope, and an explicit findings summary at the end of the report

Evertrue.title: Etsy OAuth access/refresh tokens and shared secret stored as plaintext columns in D1
Evertrue.symptom: The etsy_links table keeps shared_secret, access_token and refresh_token as plain TEXT, so anyone with D1 read access (a dump or an over-broad query) gets live read access to sellers' Etsy shops.
Evertrue.fix: Left open. Encrypt the three columns with AES-GCM using a key derived from a Worker secret before insert, decrypt on use, and add a revoke/delete-on-disconnect check.

Evertrue.title: renderLanding assumed DOM nodes that do not exist in some states (null deref blanked the landing page)
Evertrue.symptom: Landing view threw on a missing element and rendered nothing for logged-out visitors in one state.
Evertrue.fix: Null-guard each lookup and render defensively; test every route logged-out and logged-in.

Evertrue.title: root.App.applyRings called before App existed: blank SPA on cold load
Evertrue.symptom: The whole app rendered blank on first load; console showed 'Cannot read properties of undefined (applyRings)'.
Evertrue.fix: Call lazily inside render/after DOMContentLoaded and guard with root.App && root.App.applyRings; add a boot smoke test that fails on any uncaught error at load.

Evertrue.title: Etsy shows connected but syncs nothing: x-api-key was sent as keystring:shared_secret
Evertrue.symptom: The user entered their Etsy keys, OAuth succeeded, and the sync reported 'Synced 0 and 0' with no listings or orders.
Evertrue.fix: x-api-key is the keystring only; a pickShop() helper extracts the shop id defensively; the sync returns diagnostics and the client explains a connected-but-empty result instead of printing 'Synced 0 and 0'; the shared-secret field is labelled as not needed.

Evertrue.title: Sample (demo) owner would schedule sync pushes to the server
Evertrue.symptom: In ?sample=1 mode, edits to the seeded shop would queue /api/sync calls and send demo data to a real account.
Evertrue.fix: Excluded owner === 'sample' in schedule(), sync() and the post-put reschedule so sample mode never syncs; caught before first deploy.

Evertrue.title: Analysis 'Orders · 30 days' delta compared a rolling 30-day count with the previous calendar month
Evertrue.symptom: The orders KPI delta was misleading because the two figures covered different windows.
Evertrue.fix: Compute o30p (the 30 days before the current 30) and compare like for like.

Evertrue.title: Download menu PDF and CSV builders received undefined sheets; zip had no MIME type
Evertrue.symptom: After adding PDF/CSV to the download menu both buttons failed on the live page while the xlsx worked.
Evertrue.fix: Return {sheets, blob, name, tabs} from workbook() and wrap the zip in new Blob([...],{type:'application/zip'}).

Evertrue.title: Monthly goal widget ignored revenue and orders goals and edited the wrong month
Evertrue.symptom: After adding a goal the dashboard widget still said 'Set a monthly goal'.
Evertrue.fix: The widget honours profit, revenue or orders; editGoal takes the month it was opened for; a Today's goal card now leads the dashboard and a monthly-goal card sits on Money; the Studio copy reads 'New listings to publish in October 2026' with a plain explanation of monthly goal versus daily challenge.

Evertrue.title: Paste-a-link unfurl returned 403 for Etsy (bot-blocked): feature showed 'failed' with no fallback
Evertrue.symptom: Pasting an Etsy listing link produced an error; the product title/image were never filled.
Evertrue.fix: Treat 403 as 'site blocks automated fetch', fall back to parsing the URL slug for a title and ask the user to paste the details/CSV; never imply the link was verified.

Evertrue.title: Routine/To-Do seeding wrote sample rows into REAL accounts
Evertrue.symptom: Real sellers opened the Routine/Checklist and found demo tasks they never created.
Evertrue.fix: Gate all demo seeding on the sample owner (?sample=1) only; migration to remove seeded rows from real accounts by id prefix.

Evertrue.title: Sample shop seeds only when empty, so returning visitors never receive new sample content
Evertrue.symptom: After new sample content shipped (banner, logos, second shop), the same browser kept the old sample data and the new features did not appear until localStorage keys were cleared.
Evertrue.fix: Verification workaround was to clear ev_data_sample, ev_meta_sample and ev_shop_sample. The proper fix is to store a seed version and reseed on mismatch.

Evertrue.title: Sample-inbox seed never re-ran for returning sample users: sample accounts stayed empty after a data fix
Evertrue.symptom: After seeding logic was improved, anyone who had already entered sample mode saw old/empty data; only brand-new browsers saw the fix.
Evertrue.fix: Version the seed (seedVersion), and re-seed sample owners when the stored version is older; for real accounts never seed at all.

Evertrue.title: Star Seller sales minimum hard-coded at USD $300 for shops in every currency
Evertrue.symptom: GBP, EUR, CAD and AUD shops would be measured against $300.
Evertrue.fix: Added a STAR_MIN_SALES map keyed by shop currency (other currencies fall back to $300 USD), read from help.etsy.com on 2026-09-03; the About page and report were updated.

Evertrue.title: Sample product images were generated on demand at first view (slow, flaky, billed): precompute static-first
Evertrue.symptom: Sample gallery showed blank tiles for seconds and sometimes permanently when generation failed or rate-limited.
Evertrue.fix: Bake once, commit the files under public/, reference them by static URL; keep generation out of the user path entirely.

Evertrue.title: Modal closed on any click inside it because the overlay carried data-close
Evertrue.symptom: Clicking inside the modal body (fields, buttons) dismissed the modal.
Evertrue.fix: Removed data-close from the overlay and simplified the handler to close only on real [data-close] controls; found pre-deploy.

Evertrue.title: Paste-a-link fallback through keyless reader proxies cannot get past Etsy's 403 from Cloudflare egress
Evertrue.symptom: Etsy listing URLs return 403 to the Worker; the planned fallback (allorigins, codetabs, Jina reader) looked right in code and was assumed to work.
Evertrue.fix: Firecrawl first when FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is set, keyless proxies kept as best-effort with short timeouts, and the import copy says Etsy needs the key. Lesson: prove a fallback from the production egress before shipping it.

Evertrue.title: Timetable empty days were not clickable: nowhere to add a block
Evertrue.symptom: Clicking an empty day in the timetable did nothing; users could only add blocks from days that already had one.
Evertrue.fix: Bind the add-block handler to the day cell (event delegation) and show an affordance on hover/focus.

Planner Studio.title: arguments.callee ReferenceError breaks task ticking
Planner Studio.symptom: To-do items wouldn't tick off; the first render's refresh callback threw silently.
Planner Studio.fix: Replaced it with a hoisted `refreshTasks` declaration.

Planner Studio.title: Gradient theme crash from id mismatch
Planner Studio.symptom: The gradient theme never applied because its checks never matched.

Planner Studio.title: Voice-search mic threw because voiceSearch() was never defined
Planner Studio.symptom: Tapping the voice-search mic did nothing and threw a ReferenceError
Planner Studio.fix: Implemented voiceSearch() properly (found during the static + in-browser smoke sweep)

Planner Studio.title: Service worker cached a 404 for a later-added file

Planner Studio.title: Book-cover auto-fetch hung on a CORS blob fetch

Planner Studio.title: Global search returned zero results after new sections were added

Planner Studio.fix: Extended the search index to cover notes, books, content, and journal entries

Planner Studio.title: Monochrome theme hue not updating

Planner Studio.fix: Fixed the mono hue to update.

Planner Studio.title: OCR web worker used relative paths that don't resolve in worker scope
Planner Studio.symptom: Tesseract 'Magic Fill' pipeline failed to load its worker/core; status stalled and OCR never ran
Planner Studio.fix: Switched the worker/core references to absolute URLs (and copied the missing LSTM core variants so all vendor files serve)

Planner Studio.title: Schedule data-model change regression
Planner Studio.symptom: After changing schedule data from string to an object, consumers still reading it as a string could break (calm mode, week view, search, celebrate cards).
Planner Studio.fix: Updated the consumers to the new object model.

Planner Studio.title: '0/0' task counter not updating live
Planner Studio.symptom: The task counter stayed at 0/0 instead of reflecting progress.

Planner Studio.title: Bookshelf niche rendered dark in light themes because data-dark=0 still matched [data-dark]
Planner Studio.symptom: In pastel/light themes the bookshelf back-panel niche rendered with the dark-mode material
Planner Studio.fix: Target the explicit value with body[data-dark=1] instead of the bare presence selector

Planner Studio.title: Both modal dialogs render on load
Planner Studio.symptom: Two modal sheets both showed on first boot.

Planner Studio.title: Duplicate calmBtn DOM id
Planner Studio.fix: Renamed the Today hero button to `calmStart`.

Planner Studio.title: Kawaii theme buttons unreadable

Planner Studio.title: Meal grid misaligns below 860px

Planner Studio.title: PDF cover text overlapping
