Planner Studio.fix: Fixed spacing between title, subtitle and year, and rebuilt all 12 PDFs.

Coco Modules.title: Edited the wrong modules.json: only public/modules.json is served, so the live catalog never updated
Coco Modules.symptom: After editing the manifest and deploying, the live /modules.json still listed 3 modules and no voice-mic. It happened again after an earlier change that had touched both copies.
Coco Modules.fix: Copied root to public/ and redeployed. Needs a single source, a generate-on-deploy step, or a predeploy diff check.

Coco Modules.title: Module change committed by a sibling session but never deployed: live served mixed versions of the same feature
Coco Modules.symptom: Live abba-backgrounds.js contained Sunset but live theme-studio.js lacked the new rename control and the catalog tagline still said 16, while git HEAD already had the .js changes.
Coco Modules.fix: Deployed with wrangler@4.28.1 and verified by curl-grepping a unique marker in each live asset (id: 'sunset', data-e, 'The 18 background themes'), instead of trusting git status.

Coco Modules.title: Two copies of modules.json (root and public/) drifted: root was missing the double-tap-speak module
Coco Modules.symptom: The served public/modules.json listed one more module than the root manifest (14 vs 13 before the goals add), so the root copy was missing double-tap-speak.
Coco Modules.fix: Synced root to public/ and kept both identical on each add (both validated as 1-space JSON); better: generate one from the other or add a diff check.

Coco Modules.title: goal-celebrate inferred a filler word as the goal unit ('List 12 new items' -> unit 'new')
Coco Modules.symptom: A numeric goal showed the wrong unit label because the first word after the number was used verbatim.
Coco Modules.fix: Skip filler words and take the next real noun, so it now yields items / orders / sales / $; verified on 6 phrasings.

Coco Modules.title: pdf-export turned em dashes and euro signs into '?' (text encoded twice)
Coco Modules.symptom: A 'a — b · £5 €6' string rendered as 'a ? b · £5 ?6' in Preview.
Coco Modules.fix: Made enc() idempotent by keeping 128-255 as already-mapped; verified bytes 151/128/133 survive.

Coco Modules.title: routine-timetable parser ate the leading digit of a typed time and left the time phrase in the title
Coco Modules.symptom: '9:00 reply to messages 30m weekdays' parsed to title '00 reply to messages' with no start time, and '7am coffee and inbox 20m' kept '7am' inside the title.
Coco Modules.fix: Strip only a real bullet (dash, dot, star, or digits followed by . or )) and remove the matched time/range span from the title; re-ran 13 sentence fixtures.

Coco Modules.title: Theme count was stale in six places after adding Sunset/Sunrise (code 17, README 14, tagline 16, gallery cards 16/14, theme-studio README 16)
Coco Modules.symptom: abba-backgrounds.js had 17 themes while its README said 14, modules.json (root and public) and both index.html gallery cards said 16 and the theme-studio README said 16.
Coco Modules.fix: Updated all six places (14/16 to 17, later 18) and re-validated both JSON files; the durable fix is to derive the number from AbbaBackgrounds.list().length at publish time instead of typing it.

Coco Modules.title: heart-bell MutationObserver observed its own innerHTML write: infinite microtask loop froze any app on load
Coco Modules.symptom: Abba (and any app embedding the shared heart-bell module) hung silently on load when authenticated: main thread pegged, no console error, logged-out view fine.
Coco Modules.fix: disconnect() the observer around every write and re-observe after, plus a requestAnimationFrame debounce; shipped as module v1 to v2 and redeployed modules.coconvo. General rule: never let an observer's callback write inside the subtree it observes without disconnecting first.

Coco Modules.title: Live board cards blinked every poll
Coco Modules.symptom: Activity timelines/boards re-appended cards each poll, replaying the CSS entrance animation so cards flickered every ~1.5s.
Coco Modules.fix: One-shot .enter class stripped after it plays; re-render only when content or order changes. Shipped as a reusable module.

Coco Modules.title: activity-timeline keeps light cards under dark themes
Coco Modules.symptom: Dropped into a dark app the timeline cards stayed white with dark text.
Coco Modules.fix: Use CSS variables with light defaults (--atl-card, --atl-ink) and map them from the host theme.

Coco Modules.title: theme-studio swatch chips collapsed because the span had no display:block
Coco Modules.symptom: The live-preview chips rendered as thin inline slivers.
Coco Modules.fix: Set display:block on .ts-chip (done) and test the gallery once in a host with a reset stylesheet.

Coco Modules.title: to-do-list add box lost focus after each add because the list re-rendered, so rapid Enter-to-add felt broken
Coco Modules.symptom: After pressing Enter once the input blurred and further typing went nowhere.
Coco Modules.fix: Added a keepFocus flag so the new input is re-focused after render.

Coco Modules.title: to-do-list streak card rendered dark in light mode: the dark override sat outside the @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) block
Coco Modules.symptom: The routine streak card was a dark panel on a light page.
Coco Modules.fix: Kept only the explicit [data-theme="dark"] selector at top level and moved the :not([data-theme="light"]) variant inside the media query; verified light and dark in the browser.

Coco Modules.title: Registry edited in the wrong copy: root modules.json is not served, public/modules.json is, and the count had drifted
Coco Modules.symptom: A new module was added and deployed, but the live /modules.json still showed count 26 without it. The plain URL also served a stale cf-cache-status HIT for a while after deploy.
Coco Modules.fix: Same insertion applied to public/modules.json, count set to the array length, and the live registry verified with a ?v= cache-bust. Longer term, keep one source and generate count at deploy.

Fullfill.title: Auth fail-open and shared static cookie: authed() allowed everyone when ACCESS_CODE was unset; docs/files were unscoped
Fullfill.symptom: With no ACCESS_CODE secret configured every request was treated as authenticated; with it set, the session cookie was a static sha256('ff:'+code) shared by all users, every document and file was readable by any holder, and login had no rate limit.
Fullfill.fix: Real accounts: PBKDF2 + pepper password hashing, hashed random session tokens, owner column on every doc/file with cross-account access returning 404, lockout/rate limit, recovery code. Fail closed when a secret is missing. Open sign-up remains and needs a decision.

Fullfill.title: Field font names were interpolated into inline style attributes without sanitising (style injection sink)
Fullfill.symptom: A tampered form definition could put arbitrary CSS into the public fill page via the font family/size strings.
Fullfill.fix: Sanitise font strings against the known catalogue/characters before injecting them.

Fullfill.title: Public submit endpoint accepted unbounded PDF uploads (storage and denial-of-wallet abuse)
Fullfill.symptom: Anyone with a share link could post an arbitrarily large filled PDF that the Worker stored in R2/D1.
Fullfill.fix: Reject PDFs over about 10 MB with 413 before storing.

Fullfill.title: Share link filled a stale fillable PDF: recipient saw the old document version
Fullfill.symptom: A sent signing/fill link showed an older copy of the form than the one the sender last edited.
Fullfill.fix: Resolve the envelope's current file/version at open time and bump a revision; show the recipient the latest rendition, and block sending an envelope with unsaved edits.

Fullfill.title: pdf-lib flatten() left dangling /Annots references that other viewers rejected
Fullfill.symptom: Flattened exports opened in pdf.js but showed errors or blank pages in Preview/Acrobat.
Fullfill.fix: After flatten, clear or filter each page's /Annots to only live refs, then save; verify the export in more than one viewer.

Fullfill.title: Uploads froze in a hidden/background tab: requestAnimationFrame-driven pipeline never advanced
Fullfill.symptom: Import progress stalled at the first stage whenever the tab was not frontmost (including headless/background-pane tests).
Fullfill.fix: Use setTimeout/MessageChannel or a promise-based yield for pipeline steps; reserve rAF for visual updates only. Also front the tab when testing in the pane.

Fullfill.title: Dark fill band (shaded header strip) counted as a line: phantom fields and mis-snapped baselines
Fullfill.symptom: A solid shaded band was detected as many horizontal lines, producing a stack of phantom fields.
Fullfill.fix: Add a local-contrast test (the line must differ from rows directly above and below) and cap line thickness; reject filled rectangles.

Fullfill.title: Export misplaced fields on rotated/cropped PDFs (off by ~330pt)
Fullfill.symptom: Fields filled in the editor landed far from their position in the downloaded PDF for pages with /Rotate or a non-zero CropBox.
Fullfill.fix: Map through the page's rotation and CropBox origin (translate then rotate); regression-tested on rotated/cropped pages, error 330pt to under 1pt.

Fullfill.title: Round buttons, caption-as-title and letter-top phantom lines produced false fields
Fullfill.symptom: Radio/round buttons became text fields, a caption was used as the field title, and the tops of letters were detected as underlines.
Fullfill.fix: Classify near-square/round blobs as checkbox/radio, require line length >= several times local glyph height, and prefer the nearest label to the left/above rather than any caption.

Fullfill.title: Reasoning model timed out on field-labelling: default reasoning effort too high for a Worker request
Fullfill.symptom: AI label pass returned 504/timeouts on busy forms.
Fullfill.fix: Set reasoning_effort low, benchmark candidate models on the synthetic ground-truth form, and pick the fastest model that holds accuracy (non-reasoning vision model for this task).

Fullfill.title: Small-square (checkbox) detection pass was quadratic over short ink segments and hung field detection
Fullfill.symptom: After adding the checkbox snap pass, ingest showed 0 fields and empty pickers; the page sat on 'Rendering' with no console error.
Fullfill.fix: Rewrote the pass with bounded scans over size-limited candidates; detection returned and 6 fields snapped pixel-perfect.

Fullfill.title: Editor could not scroll: flex children shrank to viewport height and clipped the page
Fullfill.symptom: On long PDFs the editor canvas was clipped and no scrollbar appeared, so lower pages were unreachable.
Fullfill.fix: flex:none (or min-height:0 on the scroller plus flex-shrink:0 on pages) so the scroll container owns the overflow.

Fullfill.title: Generated PDF rendered a font-glyph calendar icon as a solid black square and a two-digit step badge wrapped
Fullfill.symptom: The fillable form's calendar affordance was a filled square and step badge '10' wrapped onto two lines in the process report.
Fullfill.fix: Drew the calendar as vector shapes (rounded box, header bar, rings, dots) and widened the badge; confirmed by rasterising the output.

Stepapa.title: Photo AI infers age band, skin tone and facial hair with no age gate
Stepapa.symptom: A fitness/social app runs an AI pipeline that infers age-band, skin-tone and facial-hair from a user-uploaded photo, and has no age verification or minimum-age gate.
Stepapa.fix: Open: add an age gate or assurance, make attribute inference opt-in with explicit consent (or drop it), and run a DPIA. Found in the legal inventory, not yet fixed.

Stepapa.title: Calibration offered to save a useless 0-spm pace when the taps were more than 3 seconds apart (web also auto-saved it)
Stepapa.symptom: Native device testing showed 5 taps spaced over 33 seconds produced 0 spm and 0 confidence, yet the result screen still offered to save the pace; the web flow auto-saved a rhythmless pace.
Stepapa.fix: Show 'Those taps were too far apart' with the accepted gap window instead of a Save action on native (b.pace.cadence <= 0), and apply the same guard on web with no auto-save of a rhythmless pace.

Stepapa.title: Calibration taps, which are real footfalls, were not added to the day's step total
Stepapa.symptom: After a one-minute pace recording the user's steps for the day stayed unchanged although every tap was a real step.
Stepapa.fix: Add the tap count to today exactly once when calibration finishes (guarded against a double save) in both the web save flow and native PaceLabView.

Stepapa.title: Native app displayed the phone pedometer count but never persisted it, so the goal ring, coins, badges, widget and sync never saw it
Stepapa.symptom: Today showed the device step count but the day record kept only manually counted steps; goal completion, coins, badges, the widget snapshot and cloud sync all ignored the pedometer. Move also refused to start until a pace had been calibrated.
Stepapa.fix: Added a persisted deviceSteps field on the day record fed from CMPedometer, dayTotal() used everywhere dayOf().steps was read, a passive web autocount (works with or without a calibrated pace), and removed the calibrate-first gate in web and native Move.

Stepapa.title: Own counted steps and distance were added to the device count, double counting a day (9,620 steps and 6.80 km instead of 9,120 and 6.43 km)
Stepapa.symptom: With 9,120 device steps and 500 manual steps the ring showed 9,620 and distance 6.80 km; the same walk counted twice.
Stepapa.fix: Use the larger of own and device steps (monotonic, never summed) and apply the same max rule to distance, keeping own distance when no device figure exists; 10/10 and 4/4 checks pass with zero calibrated paces.

Stepapa.title: Pace calibration accepted a physically impossible result (342 cm per step, 22.6 km/h) without warning
Stepapa.symptom: A tap run recovered the right 110 spm cadence but with a bad distance/step input it saved a 3.42 m step length and 22.6 km/h walking speed and showed it as the user's pace.
Stepapa.fix: Added plausibility bounds from gait literature (a sprint stride is about 1.22 m per step, so 1.6 m is a generous ceiling), an implausible-result warning with fallback to the height-based estimate in views.js, 28/28 maths tests still green.

Stepapa.title: GBP prices shown for virtual-currency purchases that are not wired to any payment processor
Stepapa.symptom: The UI shows GBP prices for buying virtual currency although no payment processor is connected, so users see a purchase offer that cannot complete.
Stepapa.fix: Open: hide the prices or label them 'coming soon' until real checkout exists. Found in the legal inventory.

Stepapa.title: Hero ring SVG was a fixed 264px inside a 203px container so the ring overflowed 29px while its text stayed left
Stepapa.symptom: On a narrow phone the steps numeral and plaque sat 29px left of the ring centre and 'STEPS TODAY' collided with the stroke.
Stepapa.fix: Size the ring from one explicit CSS variable on a wrapper that hugs it, drive the numeral size from the digit count and the ring geometry (clear radius 87.6px vs 92.5px corner), verified 8/8 viewport x digit-count combinations with no overflow.

Stepapa.title: PIN keypad felt sluggish: touch-action auto left the double-tap zoom delay and the keys used only 194px of a 248px card
Stepapa.symptom: The owner reported the keypad hard to press; keys measured 59x54 (above 44pt) but taps registered late.
Stepapa.fix: touch-action: manipulation on the keys, a wider keypad (86% of the card), taller keys (64x57), pointerdown registering digits; checked at 320, 390 and 768px.

Stepapa.title: WidgetKit extension installed with GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE was rejected by the simulator: no NSExtension dictionary
Stepapa.symptom: xcodebuild succeeded and the .appex was embedded (124 KB) but simctl install failed with a placeholder-attributes error; the widget never appeared in the gallery.
Stepapa.fix: Supplied an explicit Info.plist for the extension only, moved outside the synchronized folder to avoid a duplicate resource copy, then installed and proved the widget in the gallery and on the home screen with real step data.

Stepapa.title: Xcode build output (ios/build, 4,007 files) was committed and diverged the local and remote histories
Stepapa.symptom: git push was rejected with 22 local vs 21 remote commits carrying identical messages but different SHAs; the remote's only unique file was an Xcode build log.
Stepapa.fix: Backed up the remote as backup-remote, untracked ios/build, merged origin/main non-destructively (a force push was blocked) and re-untracked the artifacts the merge brought back; added the ignore.

Stepapa.title: Xcode scheme resolved to macOS and the build failed on a stale INFOPLIST_FILE reference
Stepapa.symptom: First native build tried macOS destinations and then failed on a missing Info-ios.plist even though GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE was YES.
Stepapa.fix: Pinned the iOS SDK / simulator destination, removed the stale INFOPLIST_FILE reference (and restored the GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE lines a substring filter also removed), then built against the iOS 26.5 SDK for an 18.5 simulator with a 17.0 deployment target.

Hello Baby.title: Weak recovery keys and unescaped attribute sinks
Hello Baby.symptom: Recovery keys were brute-forceable and some attributes were unescaped (XSS risk now that spaces are shared).
Hello Baby.fix: Strengthened recovery-key generation and escaped the attribute sinks, in Hello Baby and the same inherited code in Happy Travel.

Hello Baby.title: Countdown hero's corner edit pencil was invisible over the photo and silently wiped the due date with no confirmation
Hello Baby.symptom: User could not find an edit button on the countdown, and tapping the hidden corner pencil reset the due date instantly.
Hello Baby.fix: Added a visible Edit countdown pill that opens a sheet (name, date, gender) with every reset behind a confirm, plus a confirmed 'close this chapter quietly' path; verified cancel keeps all data.

Hello Baby.title: Entities deleted without confirmation
Hello Baby.symptom: Five places deleted data without asking.
Hello Baby.fix: Added delete confirmations to all five places plus broader edit-everything support.

Hello Baby.title: Arrival without due date routed to wrong screen
Hello Baby.symptom: A baby with no due date fell into the wrong screen.
Hello Baby.fix: Route arrival-without-due-date straight to the correct age-based screen (e.g. '3RD BIRTHDAY').

Hello Baby.title: Hero filler image picked from a remembered Unsplash ID showed the wrong subject, and a hand-edited Wikimedia thumbnail width returned no image
Hello Baby.symptom: The 'pregnant belly' default loaded baby feet in a blanket, two other remembered IDs failed, and swapping /1920px- for /1400px- in a Wikimedia Commons thumb URL gave naturalWidth 0.
Hello Baby.fix: Queried the Wikimedia Commons API, auditioned six candidates in an on-page grid, used the exact URL the API returned (verified HTTP 200 and image loads) and noted a licence swap before commercial launch.

Hello Baby.title: App showed Happy Travel nav instead of baby app
Hello Baby.symptom: The brand said Hello Baby but the nav showed Happy Travel's 'My Trips / Journey / Passport'.
Hello Baby.fix: Restored the correct baby nav (Home / Events / Babymoon & Trips / Milestones).

Hello Baby.title: Baby Tree orbit labels collided: members on adjacent rings stacked on the same spoke and parents sat over the baby's name
Hello Baby.symptom: Names such as Mum and Nana, and Dad, Grandpa Joe, Uncle Sam and Tom overlapped on the concentric rings.
Hello Baby.fix: Ring 0 starts at 180 degrees so parents flank the baby left and right, outer rings fan from the top with a per-ring offset of pi/7, avatars shrink on outer rings, labels are single-line with ellipsis on soft backing chips.

Hello Baby.title: Blurry, hard-to-read wording
Hello Baby.symptom: Text looked fuzzy and dark numbers collided with the dark silhouette.
Hello Baby.fix: Removed the glow and fixed the number/silhouette contrast.

Hello Baby.title: Budget edits buried and unfindable
Hello Baby.symptom: The user couldn't find budget edits because they were buried at the bottom of the Events tab.
Hello Baby.fix: Promoted Budget to its own standalone tab and added a hamburger menu.

Hello Baby.title: Literal \n rendering escaped
Hello Baby.symptom: A literal `\n` was showing instead of a line break.

Hello Baby.title: Photo wallpaper sized with background-size: zoom*100% letterboxed instead of covering the viewport
Hello Baby.symptom: A landscape photo behind a portrait viewport left empty bands at the top and bottom, so the wallpaper did not take up 100% of the background.
Hello Baby.fix: Use cover as the baseline and switch to zoom*100% only when zoom is above 1; ported the same rule to Happy Travel, Ever After and Planner Studio and verified bgIsCover in all four.

Prompt Vault.title: Beauty-mark descriptor produced a lip piercing
Prompt Vault.symptom: Subject prompts rendered an unwanted lip piercing.
Prompt Vault.fix: Changed subject descriptors to freckles/cheekbones/dimples, never a mark near the lips.

Prompt Vault.title: Ebook hyperlinks not rendered inline
Prompt Vault.symptom: PDF link annotations weren't appearing, undercutting the 'fully hyperlinked' claim.
Prompt Vault.fix: Drew the links inline so the ebook is fully hyperlinked (27,993 link annotations verified).

Prompt Vault.title: Mirror-reversed, garbled on-image timestamp
Prompt Vault.symptom: Generated mirror-selfie images produced a flipped, broken timestamp.
Prompt Vault.fix: Added a text-overlay clause telling the model to render on-image text as a flat, upright overlay, never inside the mirror.

Prompt Vault.title: Prompts produced generic, non-model subjects
Prompt Vault.symptom: Users got a generic subject instead of a model-grade one.
Prompt Vault.fix: Added a subject-lock/beauty-floor transform across all mega prompts.

Prompt Vault.title: Search returned zero results
Prompt Vault.symptom: Search returned 0 results despite the 'find anything you've ever written' claim.
Prompt Vault.fix: Extended the search index to include the new content types.

Prompt Vault.title: Text-fix clause injected inside the --oref placeholder
Prompt Vault.symptom: The orientation-fix clause landed inside the [your model … --oref …] placeholder, breaking it.
Prompt Vault.fix: Placed the orientation-fix clause at the end so the placeholder stays intact.

Prompt Vault.title: Transparent card background over content
Prompt Vault.symptom: A card used a transparent background causing a visual glitch.
Prompt Vault.fix: Switched it to an opaque, theme-aware background.

Prompt Vault.title: Incorrect flat '696 pages' label
Prompt Vault.symptom: All files were labeled '696 pages' but the 2028 files are actually 697-701 pages.

Hopefil World.title: Unauthenticated /api/start fetches a user-supplied URL server-side and writes to D1 with no visible rate limit
Hopefil World.symptom: Any visitor can make the Worker fetch an arbitrary URL and create rows, so the endpoint can be used to probe internal or third-party targets or to fill the database.
Hopefil World.fix: Keep the SSRF allowlist and add per-IP rate limiting, a response size cap, a body timeout and a daily write cap.

Hopefil World.title: Primary CTA white on #6B7BFF is 3.56:1 and the site had no skip link, skipped headings and two sub-4.5:1 text tiers
Hopefil World.symptom: The deep a11y pass failed the primary button (3.56:1), found no skip link on 7 of 7 routes, heading level skips, a code comment at 4.41:1 and the /start https:// prefix at 4.25:1.
Hopefil World.fix: Darken the CTA surface to 4.5:1, add a skip link to the shared layout, fix heading order, and lift the two text tiers.

Hopefil World.title: curl POST with the response discarded masked a missing endpoint and left the board at 0/38
Hopefil World.symptom: A batch of POSTs to a non-existent route all looked successful because output was thrown away, so the live board never advanced.
Hopefil World.fix: Print the HTTP status for every call (-w with the code) and stop on the first non-2xx.

Hopefil World.title: a11y.mjs and verify.mjs read the same routes.json with incompatible schemas
Hopefil World.symptom: One harness silently audited an empty or wrong route list while the other worked, so a clean run proved nothing.
Hopefil World.fix: Validate the shared routes file on load (fail loudly on an unexpected shape) or give each harness its own file.

Hopefil World.title: Measure script read font-size from one element and line-height from another, reporting a phantom body line-height gap
Hopefil World.symptom: The audit reported a body line-height ratio of 2.21 that did not exist on the page.
Hopefil World.fix: Read both computed values from the same node and print the element used with each number.

Hopefil World.title: Grid item with min-width:auto holding a long code line pushed the page 608px wider than a 390px phone
Hopefil World.symptom: At 390px the page scrolled horizontally by about 608px.
Hopefil World.fix: Set min-width:0 on the grid item and overflow-x:auto on the code block instead of hiding overflow on the page.

Hopefil World.title: Sticky side rail collapsed inside a grid with align-items:start, and a ul-only list reset left ordered-list numbers missing
Hopefil World.symptom: The sticky rail had no height to stick within, and numbered steps rendered without their markers.
Hopefil World.fix: Use align-self:start on the rail with the grid stretching, and reset list styles per list type.

Joy.title: Mail session cookie is an unsalted SHA-256 of the 6-digit PIN: identical on every login, 30 days, no logout, and recoverable offline from the cookie value
Joy.symptom: POST /api/login set cm_auth=<sha256('joy:'+code)> and returned the same 64-hex value on every login, with and without 'remember me'; the value was printed in the session transcript, the PIN is compared with !==, and there is no logout route (the HttpOnly cookie could not even be cleared to test the lock screen)
Joy.fix: Open: issue a random session id stored server-side (or HMAC of an expiry with a separate JOY_SECRET), add /api/logout that clears it, compare the PIN in constant time, and keep the login throttle

Joy.title: Outbound SEND binding is deployed unrestricted and the client chooses the From address
Joy.symptom: wrangler shows env.SEND (unrestricted) and /api/send takes {from,to,subject,body} from the request, so any signed-in or script-injected session can send DKIM-signed mail as any address on the domain, and as any other verified sender
Joy.fix: Open: set allowed_sender_addresses in wrangler.jsonc to the pinned addresses, validate from against the addresses table, and rate-limit /api/send

Joy.title: Joy Cloud puts personal data in a URL query string
Joy.symptom: Personal data is passed in a URL query string, where it leaks via browser history, Referer headers and server/access logs.
Joy.fix: Move PII out of the URL into a POST body or an opaque token; never put personal data in query strings.

Joy.title: File-request links rejected any file over 95 MB because the whole upload went through one Worker request
Joy.symptom: A sender dropping a 100 MB video on a request link failed; the sender page promised 'up to 95 MB each' while the drive itself accepted multi-GB files.
Joy.fix: Added /api/request-mpu/* routes on the drive Worker reached with a ticket scoped to that one request job; the sender page splits the file into pieces with per-piece retry and progress; a 100 MB file landed in four pieces on the live site, folder chosen server-side.

Joy.title: Owner previews of their own share link were counted as recipient views and downloads (and could trigger a receipt)
Joy.symptom: Opening a Cloud share link as the owner incremented views/downloads and wrote a link-activity row, so the activity list and the first-download receipt could not be trusted.
Joy.fix: Owner preview requests carry preview=1 (propagated through file, download and zip URLs in share.js); the share Worker counts nothing and records no event for them; verified views/downloads/cloud_link_events unchanged after a preview.

Joy.title: Completion message called Joy a complete $0 email platform while the research had found Email Sending is a beta that is transactional-only by policy
Joy.symptom: The research lane stated Cloudflare Email Sending is public beta, transactional-only by its FAQ, on shared IPs with an unpublished adaptive daily quota, so customer-composed mailbox traffic should go through SES; the final message, the Handbook and the Dossier then described person-to-person sending from any address as live and finished, without that caveat
Joy.fix: Open: add the policy and quota caveat to the Handbook send section and the status copy, state the real monthly cost including the Workers plan, and note the SES fallback if sending is throttled or the beta changes

Joy.title: Shared links rows clipped their status pills on medium-width windows
Joy.symptom: On medium viewports the Shared links list cut off the Last opened / password / expiry pills at the right edge.
Joy.fix: Rows now wrap their pill group on medium widths (commit 'shared-links rows wrap on medium widths') and the layout was re-checked live.

Ever After.title: Service worker pins returning users to old build
Ever After.symptom: Returning visitors saw stale builds — old splash rings, white space under content, and a mis-sized rainbow ring.
Ever After.fix: Made navigations network-first and bumped the cache version to purge stale caches; the identical bug was also fixed in Planner Studio.

Ever After.title: Join boot race gives joiners the wrong cloud key
Ever After.symptom: Users joining a shared space were given their own cloud key and shown the wrong 'your key' popup.
Ever After.fix: Fixed the boot races so joiners use the correct shared key and popup.

Ever After.title: Wedding voice dictation dumped every spoken item into Guests
Ever After.symptom: Speaking a mixed rundown (budget, vendor, song, gift, to-do) routed everything into the Guests list
Ever After.fix: Rewrote it to split on command boundaries so items route to guests/budget/vendors/tasks/songs/gifts correctly

Ever After.title: Choose-a-photo box shows literal ${imgIconSVG(34)}
Ever After.symptom: The photo-picker box displayed the literal text `${imgIconSVG(34)}` (plus a fallback clock glyph) instead of an image icon.
Ever After.fix: Broke out of the single-quoted string to call imgIconSVG so a real image icon renders.

Ever After.title: tvPhoto icon printed as literal text
Ever After.symptom: `${IMG_ICON(32)}` showed as literal text in tvPhoto instead of the icon.
Ever After.fix: Built the string with concatenation so IMG_ICON is actually called.

Ever After.title: Corrupted emoji entry
Ever After.symptom: One corrupted emoji entry had slipped into the data.

Hallalu Bookings.title: Public unthrottled billable /api/chat with client-supplied context (denial-of-wallet and prompt injection surface)
Hallalu Bookings.symptom: Anyone can POST to the booking page chat endpoint without auth or limits; each call runs a Workers AI 70B model billed to the owner, and the page context is accepted from the client.
Hallalu Bookings.fix: Rate limit (per IP and per page, with a daily ceiling), cap message/context size, rebuild grounding context server-side from the page id, and return the FAQ fallback when over budget.

Hallalu Bookings.title: Mixing ?? with && without parentheses is a SyntaxError in esbuild/Workers
Hallalu Bookings.symptom: wrangler deploy failed to bundle the Worker with a cryptic syntax error on a chat-context line.
Hallalu Bookings.fix: Parenthesise ((a ?? b) && c). Run the bundler locally before deploy.

Hallalu Bookings.title: Concurrent bookings claim the same slot (double-booking race)
Hallalu Bookings.symptom: Two visitors open the same booking page, both see a slot as free, and both submit within seconds — the app accepts both and the owner is double-booked.
Hallalu Bookings.fix: Make the slot the source of truth: add a DB unique constraint / conditional insert on (owner_or_resource, start, end) so the second write fails, re-validate availability server-side at submit time, and on conflict return a friendly 'just taken — pick another time'. Optionally hold a short soft-lock while the visitor fills the form.

Hallalu Bookings.title: Availability rendered in owner's timezone, not the visitor's
Hallalu Bookings.symptom: Slots show the business's local hours to every visitor regardless of where they are, so an out-of-area client books '2pm' meaning their own 2pm and shows up at the wrong hour.
Hallalu Bookings.fix: Store all slots in UTC, detect the visitor's timezone (Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone), render every time converted to it, always print an explicit timezone label plus a picker to override, and spell out both parties' timezones in the confirmation.

Hallalu Bookings.title: Index-keyed edit persistence misaligned after reorder/delete: edits saved onto the wrong service/slot
Hallalu Bookings.symptom: After removing or reordering an item, inline edits were saved against the wrong row.
Hallalu Bookings.fix: Key every editable row by id and look it up at save time.

Hallalu Bookings.title: Orphaned dead whitespace in FAQ + Policies section
Hallalu Bookings.symptom: The FAQ and Policies cards sat only in the right column while the left column ended at the testimonials card, leaving a dead bottom-left quadrant.
Hallalu Bookings.fix: Restructured the section into a balanced editorial layout — a full-width gallery strip then a 2x2 equal-height card grid (About / Testimonials / FAQ / Policies) so rows align and nothing is orphaned.

Wedding Planner.title: openpyxl StyleProxy crash on font copy
Wedding Planner.symptom: xlsx generation failed when copying fonts.
Wedding Planner.fix: Apply named fonts conditionally instead of copying the StyleProxy.

Wedding Planner.title: Analysis donut rendered incorrectly
Wedding Planner.symptom: The analysis donut chart displayed wrong.

Wedding Planner.title: Duplicated block in wedding-party view
Wedding Planner.symptom: The wedding party showed a duplicated half-block.
Wedding Planner.fix: Removed the duplicate lines and converted the cramped table to readable cards + editor.

Wedding Planner.title: Filler images not loading (naturalWidth 0)
Wedding Planner.fix: Store the image URL directly and let the `` element load it.

Wedding Planner.title: Seating flow dead-ends after adding a table
Wedding Planner.symptom: Adding a table left an empty table with no way forward.
Wedding Planner.fix: Added capacity meters, per-table '+ Seat a guest here' dropdowns, meal tallies, auto-seat and a 'still to seat' pool.

Wedding Planner.title: Nested git repo leaked into monorepo commit
Wedding Planner.symptom: A wedding-planner gitlink was committed into the BUDGETLEVELUP monorepo.
Wedding Planner.fix: Removed the leaked gitlink from the monorepo commit.

ABS.title: Admin API shipped in 'open bootstrap' mode: unauthenticated until an admin user exists, including product CRUD and billable AI assist
ABS.symptom: On production, GET /api/admin/products and the AI assist endpoint answered without any credentials while no admin account existed.
ABS.fix: Not fixed in the session. Fix: require a deploy-time secret or one-time claim token to create the first admin, never branch the auth check on 'no admin yet', and throttle the AI assist endpoint.

ABS.title: A research 'block for v1' recommendation was hard-coded as a legal block, excluding cosmetics/personal care
ABS.symptom: The catalogue refused the biggest TikTok Shop category and the user's explicit 'personal hygiene' scope although selling them only needs a gate.
ABS.fix: Moved cosmetics and installed batteries from blocked to gated (named Responsible Person, CPSR reference, SCPN/CPNP, ingredient list; UN38.3 for batteries) while keeping genuinely licensed categories blocked; gate re-tested at 47 rules (19 clean, 13 gated, 15 blocked).

ABS.title: Voice intent parser matched substrings: 'home' in 'trending home decor' went to the homepage and 'sell' fired inside 'best selling'
ABS.symptom: Spoken commands navigated to the wrong place; 'add this to my basket' only opened the basket.
ABS.fix: Word-boundary matching, search/filter phrases checked before navigation words, and an add-to-basket intent that acts; testing before wiring found five defects and the parser reached 17/17 intents ('show me trending home decor under $50' now yields category, price cap and sort).

ABS.title: Denied microphone permission closed the voice panel, hiding both the error and the command list
ABS.symptom: Pressing V with the mic blocked flashed a toast and closed the panel, leaving the user with no explanation or help.
ABS.fix: For not-allowed/service-not-allowed/audio-capture errors the panel stays open with a 'Voice needs microphone access' message above the command list.

ABS.title: Keyword-matched filler photos (loremflickr) ignored the lock param, so unrelated products shared one fallback image
ABS.symptom: A vase, a throw and a washi-tape set all showed the same cat-statue photo even though every image URL was unique.
ABS.fix: Switched to per-product deterministic picsum seeds derived from the product id; verified 63 products have 63 distinct first images (duplicates: 0), accepting 'distinct but not subject-matched' over duplicated.

Listing Lab Pro.title: SSRF via /api/open and /api/fetch
Listing Lab Pro.symptom: Server-side fetch endpoints could be pointed at arbitrary internal hosts.
Listing Lab Pro.fix: Added a host allowlist to /api/open and /api/fetch in worker.js.

Listing Lab Pro.title: XSS in Listing Lab render path
Listing Lab Pro.symptom: Untrusted content could execute script in Listing Lab.
Listing Lab Pro.fix: Applied output sanitization to close the XSS vector.

Listing Lab Pro.title: AI misattributed quotes between listings
Listing Lab Pro.symptom: The analyzer attributed one listing's quote to a different listing.
Listing Lab Pro.fix: Tightened the prompt and re-ran 10 listings to confirm correct attribution.

Listing Lab Pro.title: Digit confusion when reading listing images
Listing Lab Pro.fix: Added proper image preprocessing and generalized the digit-confusion fix.

Listing Lab Pro.title: Scraper pulled related-item ads and foreign shops
Listing Lab Pro.symptom: Analyses were polluted by related-item ads and other shops' listings, which would have produced wrong results.
Listing Lab Pro.fix: Filter out related-item ads and keep only the dominant shop, detected via the shop ID embedded in image URLs.

Analysis.title: Bulk edit missed 16 of 35 analyses: the ANALYSES array mixes single-quoted JS and double-quoted JSON entry styles
Analysis.symptom: A first pass baked and wired hero images into 19 analyses and the grep count looked complete (19/19), but the live DOM showed 35 cards with 16 still lacking a thumbnail.
Analysis.fix: Counted both styles (grep -c '"slug":'), baked and wired the second set anchored after each "slug": line with matching quoting, node --check, then verified against rendered output (querySelectorAll count: 35/35 thumbs, 0 broken) instead of trusting the grep count.

Analysis.title: Interactive cost-compare artifact: the cost-per-prompt slider was mis-scaled 10x against its model defaults
Analysis.symptom: In the first Max-vs-API-credits calculator the per-prompt slider value disagreed with each model's default cost by a factor of ten, so the 'credits last N months' and crossover figures were wrong.
Analysis.fix: Rewrote the calculator cents-based with a full model roster and by-hand vs at-volume modes, then replayed the actual slider scaling in Node for both modes (e.g. 10 prompts/day Sonnet = $13/mo; 1,000 sites on Haiku $500 to Fable $9,000) and republished.

Analysis.title: Archived Workers AI cost report says Cloudflare now offers four video models, though Cloudflare's own pricing page lists none
Analysis.symptom: The cloudflare-workers-ai-image-video-costs report and its companion artifact state that Workers AI does text and image to video (LTX-2.5 Fast, Hailuo-2.3, Vidu Q3 Pro, Pruna avatar) with market rates of about $0.08 to $0.30 per second; two later fetches of the primary pricing page found no video rows, and the Joy Day audit removed the same figures as invented
Analysis.fix: Open: append a correction report (the archive is append-only) stating availability is unconfirmed and no Workers AI video price is published; add a rule that any 'platform X offers Y' claim needs the platform's own page

Analysis.title: Downloaded report HTML kept root-relative /img/ paths so images broke when opened off the origin
Analysis.symptom: A saved report opened from disk or email showed broken images.
Analysis.fix: Rewrite /img/ to absolute https URLs in the ?download=1 response (done).

BirthdayTreat.title: Text-wish 'note' tab posted kind 'note' but the API only accepts 'text': silent 400, wish never saved
BirthdayTreat.symptom: Friends typing a written wish saw it appear to submit, but nothing was stored.
BirthdayTreat.fix: Map tab to kind 'text' on the client, share the kind enum between client and server tests, and always surface non-2xx responses to the user.

BirthdayTreat.title: An empty/failed wish card broke the CSS multi-column masonry layout
BirthdayTreat.symptom: One card with no media collapsed or spanned columns, pushing the rest of the wall out of alignment.
BirthdayTreat.fix: Skip rendering empty cards, set break-inside:avoid, and give every card a minimum height.

BirthdayTreat.title: Flagship 'add your wish' action was below the fold on mobile
BirthdayTreat.symptom: First-time visitors to a birthday link did not see how to post a wish without scrolling.
BirthdayTreat.fix: Pin the primary CTA in the first viewport (sticky bar); measure at 375x667.

BirthdayTreat.title: Recorded video/voice MIME with ';codecs=' parameter mapped to '.bin' extension
BirthdayTreat.symptom: Recorded wishes were stored in R2 as .bin and would not play inline in Safari/Chrome.
BirthdayTreat.fix: Strip parameters (split(';')[0].trim().toLowerCase()) before lookup and also set the response Content-Type explicitly on read.

Claude Code Browser pane.title: javascript_exec with a top-level return fails with an unhelpful SyntaxError: Illegal return statement
Claude Code Browser pane.symptom: Snippets that end with return value failed immediately; the tool reported only the SyntaxError.
Claude Code Browser pane.fix: Write the value as the last expression, or wrap the code in an IIFE; keep this in the Browser verification checklist.

Claude Code Browser pane.title: Pane viewport reports 0 width and stale computed styles, so layout measurements are wrong
Claude Code Browser pane.symptom: getComputedStyle and bounding boxes returned zero-width or stale values while the rendered pixels were correct.
Claude Code Browser pane.fix: Front the tab, wait a frame, and trust a screenshot or a re-measured value over a single early reading; resize explicitly before measuring.

Claude Code Browser pane.title: preview_start refused a configured port held by another chat's server, and the verification then ran against that other session's process
Claude Code Browser pane.symptom: preview_start name postplan failed with 'Port 8823 is in use by another chat's dev server'; the run carried on by fetching and rendering http://localhost:8823 directly, so the screenshots came from a server it did not start and whose working tree a second session was editing
Claude Code Browser pane.fix: Set autoPort in launch.json (and drop hard-coded --port flags) for shared projects, or start a private server on a free port and assert its pid before treating a 200 as proof

Claude Code Browser pane.title: Screenshots go blank on very tall pages and computer actions time out when the pane is not displayed
Claude Code Browser pane.symptom: Full-page captures of tall pages and captures after scrolling far down returned a blank slice; with the pane hidden, screenshot timed out after 5s and scroll after 30s.
Claude Code Browser pane.fix: Call tabs_select to front the pane, capture one viewport at a time (or hoist the element to the top / scroll_to a ref), and fall back to DOM reads for proof.

Joy Day.title: 6-digit PIN gate shipped with no attempt throttle in code or tests
Joy Day.symptom: The dashboard holds copies of every generated image behind a 6-digit PIN; the auth assertions in the harness (wrong PIN, tampered cookie, expiry, locked routes) never cover repeated wrong guesses and no limiter appears in the session's code, so the 1,000,000-value space can be walked through POST /auth
Joy Day.fix: Open: count failures per IP and per day in the append-only store, return 429 with a lock window after five, and add a test that the sixth wrong PIN is refused even when the seventh is right

Joy Day.title: Daily and monthly figures called composed carousel slides generations
Joy Day.symptom: Today read '8 generations' when only 1 image had cost any Neurons; seven composed slides at 0 N were counted as generations in the day, month and lifetime totals
Joy Day.fix: Count generations as neurons > 0 and images as all rows, in the day, month and lifetime queries and in the page copy ('1 generation, of 8 images today'), with tests for both

Joy Day.title: 'Joy Day' collides with Happy Money's JOY mark for personal-finance software
Joy Day.symptom: Joy Day is a personal expenditure/budget dashboard. Happy Money holds UK 'JOY' UK00003310491 in classes 9/36/42, which covers personal-finance, budget and expense-tracking software, live to 2028.
Joy Day.fix: Open: rename (rated HIGH risk in the clearance lane).

Joy Day.title: Usage history depends on a manual sync script, and locking the dashboard broke the embeddable badge
Joy Day.symptom: The count is only true as of the last manual run of sync-pixelbake.mjs, nothing schedules it, and /usage.svg moved behind the PIN gate so any pasted badge now shows a 401
Joy Day.fix: Open: add a scheduled pull from a route Pixelbake pushes to, or a cron on the machine, and decide per route which data is safe to expose (a percent-only badge token)

PatentCake.title: Unauthenticated GET /api/inventions exposes all 24 invention disclosures
PatentCake.symptom: curl returned HTTP 200 with count 24 and no auth. Every disclosure, including the 'candidate' inventions and drafted claim language describing the other apps' internals, is publicly readable.
PatentCake.fix: Open: put the read routes behind the owner auth or PATENT_KEY now, and treat anything already served as published for prior-art purposes.

PatentCake.title: Auto-derived slug truncated at 80 characters mid-word on an append-only registry, so it can never be fixed
PatentCake.symptom: Filing the patentscan disclosure created the permanent slug authorship-time-invention-harvester-the-coding-agent-triages-and-files-its-own-i, cut off mid-word. The registry triggers reject UPDATE and DELETE so it cannot be renamed; fixing it means filing a duplicate entry.
PatentCake.fix: Truncate at a word boundary and cap the title length used for slugs; make pc.mjs print the final slug and require --slug (or a confirmation) when the derived one is cut. The patentscan skill now passes a short explicit slug.

PatentCake.title: Sub-agent false negative shipped as 'does not exist': zsh unquoted --include glob and truncated output
PatentCake.symptom: A miner reported a capability absent from the codebase, and the registry marked a disclosure 'not present'; it was in fact in the repo.
PatentCake.fix: Quote globs ('--include=*.js') or use ripgrep; treat 'not found' as 'not verified' until a second method confirms; verify the critic, not just the claim. Restored the vision-to-watchlist disclosure.

PatentCake.title: Legend colours used a CSS custom property that was not defined in that scope
PatentCake.symptom: Status legend dots rendered transparent/black instead of their category colours.
PatentCake.fix: Use the same token names as the stylesheet and a var() fallback; add a check that every var(--*) used is defined.

Social LevelUp.title: XSS via paste into contenteditable notes editor
Social LevelUp.symptom: Pasting HTML into the notes editor could inject script.
Social LevelUp.fix: Sanitized pasted content in the notes editor and applied the same fix to the budget app's notes editor.

Social LevelUp.title: cur0 is not defined crash on post save
Social LevelUp.symptom: Saving a post with income entered crashed the app.
Social LevelUp.fix: Guarded with a typeof money0 check so income posts save cleanly.

Social LevelUp.title: Older profiles crash on missing state fields
Social LevelUp.symptom: Profiles created before new features crashed on load.
Social LevelUp.fix: Backfilled the new state fields in normalize() so old profiles load.

Social LevelUp.title: To-do done button crash
Social LevelUp.symptom: Clicking a to-do's done button threw undefined.split.
Social LevelUp.fix: Aligned the dataset key naming so the done button reads correctly.

Capital Signal.title: LazyVideo removed the video element when autoplay was blocked, and a duplicate HEAD-probe handler aborted the request
Capital Signal.symptom: On browsers that refuse autoplay the hero video vanished entirely; the console showed ERR_ABORTED from a second HEAD probe.
Capital Signal.fix: Keep the element on play() rejection (show the poster and a play control); verify the source server-side and mark it data-verified; lazy-start with IntersectionObserver; delete the duplicate probe.

Capital Signal.title: Two hero variants in the DOM at once gave the page two h1 elements
Capital Signal.symptom: The V1 and V2 heroes were both rendered with one hidden by CSS, so the a11y audit and assistive tech saw two h1s and duplicate landmarks.
Capital Signal.fix: Mark the inactive variant inert and aria-hidden (or do not render it) and assert exactly one h1 in the accessibility tree.

Capital Signal.title: First git add -A swept 254 evidence files into the repo and inflated .git to 163MB
Capital Signal.symptom: The initial commit of a new project carried screenshots and competitor captures, making the repository 163MB before anything shipped.
Capital Signal.fix: Untrack screenshots and competitors, rewrite the unpushed history, add them to .gitignore; keep evidence in Aprizely shots, not in git.

GitBagel.title: esc() HTML helper does not escape quotes → attribute-context XSS
GitBagel.symptom: User-controlled data interpolated into an HTML attribute can break out of the attribute and inject markup/script.
GitBagel.fix: Also escape ' and " (' / ") in esc(), or set values via setAttribute/textContent instead of string-building attributes.

GitBagel.title: Sessions created before the accounts cookie existed were not folded into the account switcher
GitBagel.symptom: After deploying multi-account switching, signing in again showed only the new account and lost the earlier one.
GitBagel.fix: Fold the current valid session token into the accounts list on every signin and signup (done).

GitBagel.title: Name violates the Git trademark policy on 'Git' as a syllable or portmanteau
GitBagel.symptom: The register search found no hit, but the Git project's trademark policy bars 'Git' as a syllable or portmanteau in third-party product names (GitHub and GitLab are grandfathered).
GitBagel.fix: Open: rename, or obtain written permission from the Software Freedom Conservancy.

Payrails.title: Rank by value sorts figures that use different measurement bases as if they were comparable
Payrails.symptom: Re-ranking by value orders Pix (about $6.5T), UPI ($3.5T), MTN MoMo ($500B), M-Pesa ($450B) and Telebirr ($20B) on one scale, although the research itself found MTN MoMo quoted anywhere from roughly $342B to $1.1T depending on basis, and entries mix annual and cumulative values and registered versus active users.
Payrails.fix: Store value as low, high, basis and year per system, sort on the midpoint with a visible basis badge, and caveat or disable the cross-basis sort.

Payrails.title: Undated forward-looking statements (IPO looming, IPO in prep) on a ranking page will go stale
Payrails.symptom: The ranked board says GCash has a ~$8B IPO looming and Airtel Money has an IPO in prep, with no as-of date, source date or hedge, on a site whose data is dated 2025 to 2026.
Payrails.fix: Date-stamp every forward-looking line (as of the month, with the source) or remove it, and add a lint step to the deploy script that flags words such as looming, upcoming, soon, plans to and expected in static copy.

Remembrance.title: Inline FALLBACK dataset in index.html drifted from data.json, so a failed fetch showed an older, incomplete record
Remembrance.symptom: The page loads public/data.json at runtime and falls back to a copy of the dataset inlined in index.html. After data.json was rewritten with new faiths, the race and ethnicity lenses, countries and perpetrators, the inline copy still held the earlier faith-only data. Whenever the fetch failed, for example in the local file preview the editor pane opens after each edit, the page silently showed only the original faiths and the lens buttons had no data to switch to. The user reported the lenses as not working.
Remembrance.fix: Make data.json the single source: inline it into index.html at deploy time with a tiny build script, or drop the fallback and show a visible load-error state. The shipped page now also retries the live /data.json with a CORS header; add a deploy check that asserts FALLBACK equals data.json.

Remembrance.title: Headline lives-recorded total sums a single reporting-year count with one-time historical event tolls
Remembrance.symptom: The All-history total (about 8.1 million, and about 12 million under the Race lens once the enslavement toll was added) adds the Open Doors latest-year figure (4,849 for the year to Sep 2025) to multi-decade one-time event tolls from sources with very different methods and ranges, and the per-day rate is derived from that same annual figure. The basis of each number (annual rate, one-time estimate, contested range) is visible only per entry.
Remembrance.fix: Add a basis field (annual, one-time, cumulative) and either exclude annual-rate rows from cumulative totals or show them separately; show the low-to-high range beside the headline total and keep the contested flag visible on the card, not only in About.

Breadcrumb Admin.title: Admin surface kept off the user-facing app
Breadcrumb Admin.symptom: Putting admin oversight (which reads the app D1) inside the main app would widen its attack surface.
Breadcrumb Admin.fix: Admin runs as a separate passcode-gated Worker that reads the app D1; nothing admin ships in the user bundle.

Breadcrumb Plan.title: Business plan and /deck must not leak on any direct path
Breadcrumb Plan.symptom: A passcode-gated business plan plus /deck could leak via direct asset paths (plan.html.txt, src, deck).
Breadcrumb Plan.fix: Plan and deck live on a separate PLAN_PASS-gated Worker; verified every direct path returns the lock screen.

Bug Ledger Pitch.title: Deck chip truncated the name to M...
Bug Ledger Pitch.symptom: A slide chip clipped the label (e.g. M...) instead of showing the full name.
Bug Ledger Pitch.fix: Chip yields width first and titles wrap to two lines; also added reading-progress and tick-off.

Claude Code.title: SendUserFile upload of a 2.1MiB screenshot returned 400 to Remote Control viewers
Claude Code.symptom: A full-size screenshot could not be delivered to a Remote Control viewer; the upload failed with a 400.
Claude Code.fix: Downscale or JPEG-encode images below the limit before SendUserFile and report the size in the failure.

Currency Picker.title: Currency picker logic duplicated per app
Currency Picker.symptom: The 153-currency parse-search picker was re-implemented in each app, duplicating a whole class of currency bugs.
Currency Picker.fix: Extracted to a standalone dependency-free module (CurrencyPicker.search/open/button) that ships its own sheet and CSS.

Happy Travel.title: Recovery keys generated with Math.random (brute-forceable)
Happy Travel.symptom: Cloud-data recovery keys came from Math.random (~15.5M combos); the key IS the password to a users synced blob, so the space is scannable.
Happy Travel.fix: Regenerated recovery keys with crypto.getRandomValues (~39 quadrillion combos). Same fix applied to Hello Baby.

Kairos.title: Unsupportable 47% more productive landing claim
Kairos.symptom: The landing asserted 47% more productive and other stats with no citable source.
Kairos.fix: Cut to verified-only claims; validated the manual-first default against real, still-true competitor gaps.

Kindly.title: Opaque gate never left, so Take-me-in did nothing
Kindly.symptom: The sign-in gate stayed opaque over the booted app and the Take-me-in button appeared dead.
Kindly.fix: Global [hidden]{display:none!important} near the CSS reset; pad rebuilt to exactly 5 digits with phone letters.

PostPlan.title: Starter posts added after a user's first visit never appear: a single boolean seeded flag gates seeding
PostPlan.symptom: New sample carousels (navy edition, the Bug Ledger, Pixelbake and Aprizely starter sets, versions 4 and 5) did not show for anyone who had already opened PostPlan.
PostPlan.fix: Seed by id: each starter registers under its id and boot adds any SAMPLES id that is missing from state (commit 'seed starters by id', then versions 4 and 5 registered).

Sell skill.title: Playbook cites a 53.1% early-branding figure that could not be found in any source
Sell skill.symptom: When the evidence was refreshed the 53.1% System1 early-branding number in sell-playbook.md could not be located anywhere; agents running /sell would repeat it in paid-ad strategy
Sell skill.fix: Open: remove or replace the number, and give every playbook figure a source URL, read date and a quoted line; mark graded SIGNAL until re-opened

SkillSea.title: Searching a hyphenated skill name with a space ('deep standard') returned zero results
SkillSea.symptom: After deep-standard was catalogued, typing 'deep standard' showed 0 cards while 'deep-standard' showed 1; the session dismissed it as expected because skill names have no spaces
SkillSea.fix: Open: normalise both the haystack and the query (lowercase, replace - and _ with space, collapse spaces) and match every query word, not the whole string

Unknown.title: Screenshot box completely unstyled
